content.en: Your task in “Greetings” is to recognise when “nice to meet you” is useful. Identify what the speaker needs, use the new language in context, and respond in complete sentences. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Salomlashish” darsida “tanishganimdan xursandman” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Suhbatdoshning ehtiyojini aniqlang, yangi til birliklarini vaziyatda ishlating va to‘liq gaplar bilan javob bering. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.
content.modelEn: Aziza meets Bekzod at a language club.
content.modelUz: Aziza til klubida Bekzod bilan uchrashadi.

content.en: Aziza meets Bekzod at a language club. She says, “Hello! My name is Aziza. Nice to meet you.” Bekzod smiles and says, “Nice to meet you too. How are you?” They say goodbye after the lesson.
content.uz: Aziza til klubida Bekzod bilan uchrashadi. U: “Salom! Mening ismim Aziza. Tanishganimdan xursandman”, deydi. Bekzod kulib: “Men ham xursandman. Qalaysiz?” deb so‘raydi. Darsdan keyin ular xayrlashadi.

content.en: Your task in “Time and dates” is to recognise when “hour” is useful. Identify what the speaker needs, use the new language in context, and respond in complete sentences. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.

Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.

content.en: The first laptop is cheaper than the second, but it is also slower. The second has a better screen and a longer battery life. For simple work, the cheaper laptop is enough. For graphic design, the other one is more useful.

content.modelEn: Public parks improve life in busy cities.
content.modelUz: Jamoat bog‘lari gavjum shaharlarda hayotni yaxshilaydi.

content.en: Public parks improve life in busy cities. First, they offer free places to walk and exercise. For example, families can spend time outdoors without paying a fee. Therefore, city planners should protect green public spaces.
content.uz: Jamoat bog‘lari gavjum shaharlarda hayotni yaxshilaydi. Birinchidan, ular yurish va mashq uchun bepul joydir. Masalan, oilalar pul to‘lamasdan tashqarida vaqt o‘tkaza oladi. Shuning uchun shahar rejalovchilari yashil hududlarni asrashi kerak.

content.en: A community library has low attendance. The team first interviews local residents to identify the root cause. They discover that opening hours conflict with working schedules. After testing evening hours for a month, they compare attendance and cost before deciding what to do next.

content.en: For a B2 capstone project, a group in Namangan designs a proposal for safer pedestrian routes to local schools. They compare a survey of parents with observed traffic at two crossings and must decide which evidence is strong enough to support a recommendation. The final report presents two practical measures and acknowledges budget limits.
content.uz: B2 yakuniy loyihasida Namangandagi guruh maktabga piyoda qatnovni xavfsizlashtirish taklifini tayyorlaydi. Ular ota-onalar so‘rovini ikkita o‘tish joyidagi transport kuzatuvi bilan solishtirib, tavsiyani qaysi dalil asoslashini tanlaydi. Yakuniy hisobot ikki amaliy chorani taklif qilib, byudjet cheklovini tan oladi.

content.en: At an international research symposium in Tashkent, a speaker explains the limits of a large survey on remote work. She distinguishes correlation from causation, compares the findings with a smaller follow-up study and anticipates a question about underrepresented groups. Her conclusion makes a conditional recommendation instead of overstating what the evidence can prove.
content.uz: Toshkentdagi xalqaro ilmiy anjumanda ma’ruzachi masofadan ishlash haqidagi katta so‘rovning cheklovlarini tushuntiradi. U bog‘liqlikni sababiylikdan ajratadi, natijalarni kichikroq keyingi tadqiqot bilan taqqoslaydi va kam qamrab olingan guruhlar haqida savolni oldindan ko‘radi. Xulosada dalil isbotlay olmaydigan narsani qat’iy aytmay, shartli tavsiya beradi.

content.en: A C1 capstone learner prepares a policy memorandum on whether universities should adopt automated admissions screening. One source reports faster processing, but another warns that historical data may reproduce unfair selection patterns. The learner evaluates the evidence, recommends independent auditing and explains what new findings could change the conclusion.
content.uz: C1 yakuniy ishida o‘quvchi universitetlarga avtomatik qabul saralashni joriy etish haqida siyosiy xulosa yozadi. Bir manba ish tezlashishini aytadi, ikkinchisi esa eski ma’lumotlar adolatsiz tanlovni takrorlashi mumkinligini ogohlantiradi. O‘quvchi dalillarni baholab, mustaqil tekshiruvni tavsiya qiladi va qaysi yangi natija xulosani o‘zgartirishi mumkinligini tushuntiradi.

content.headingEn: Understand the skill: Foundation and diagnostic
content.en: Your task in “Foundation and diagnostic” is to recognise when “diagnostic” is useful. Read the task conditions, practise the specific IELTS skill, and justify answers with the evidence in this unit. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Asoslar va diagnostika” darsida “darajani aniqlash” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Topshiriq shartini o‘qing, shu IELTS ko‘nikmasini mashq qiling va javoblarni matndagi dalil bilan asoslang. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.
content.modelEn: Farida is preparing for IELTS Academic.
content.modelUz: Farida IELTS Academic imtihoniga tayyorlanmoqda.

grammar.en: Use a past-tense verb when you describe an earlier test result; use the present simple when you describe a continuing weakness.
grammar.uz: Oldingi test natijasini aytganda o‘tgan zamon, davom etayotgan kamchilik haqida gapirganda hozirgi oddiy zamon ishlating.

task.en: Write four sentences: your starting strength, your weakest skill, one measurable weekly goal and your review date.
task.uz: To‘rtta gap yozing: dastlabki kuchli tomoningiz, eng zaif ko‘nikmangiz, haftalik o‘lchanadigan maqsadingiz va tekshirish sanasi.

model.en: My reading is stronger than my listening. I missed dates in my first listening task. I will practise number dictation for fifteen minutes every morning. I will check my progress next Friday.
model.uz: O‘qishim tinglashimdan kuchliroq. Birinchi tinglash mashqida sanalarni eshitmay qoldim. Har kuni ertalab o‘n besh daqiqa raqamlarni eshitib yozishni mashq qilaman. Keyingi juma rivojlanishimni tekshiraman.

pitfall.en: Do not describe a single practice result as an official band score.
pitfall.uz: Bitta mashq natijasini rasmiy IELTS bali deb ko‘rsatmang.

content.en: Farida is preparing for IELTS Academic. In her first practice she understands a short lecture but misses two numbers; in reading she takes too long on headings, and her essay has no clear overview of its argument. She records these three gaps in a study log and selects a different strategy for each skill.
content.uz: Farida IELTS Academic imtihoniga tayyorlanmoqda. Birinchi mashqda u qisqa ma’ruzani tushunadi, lekin ikkita raqamni eshitmay qoladi. O‘qishda sarlavhalarga juda ko‘p vaqt sarflaydi, inshosida esa fikrning umumiy yo‘nalishi aniq emas. U uchta kamchilikni daftariga yozib, har bir ko‘nikma uchun alohida usul tanlaydi.

examples.en: I completed a baseline assessment before choosing my weekly study targets.
examples.uz: Haftalik maqsadlarimni tanlashdan oldin boshlang‘ich baholashdan o‘tdim.

examples.en: The results showed that my listening accuracy was lower than my reading accuracy.
examples.uz: Natijalarim tinglashdagi aniqligim o‘qishdagidan past ekanini ko‘rsatdi.

examples.en: I recorded each mistake in a notebook instead of simply counting the score.
examples.uz: Men faqat ballni sanash o‘rniga har bir xatoni daftarga yozdim.

examples.en: My target band is realistic only if I practise all four language skills.
examples.uz: To‘rtala til ko‘nikmasini mashq qilsamgina maqsad qilgan balimga erisha olaman.

examples.en: The first diagnostic identified slow reading as a major weakness.
examples.uz: Birinchi diagnostika sekin o‘qishimni katta kamchilik deb aniqladi.

examples.en: I now review incorrect answers and explain why the alternatives were wrong.
examples.uz: Endi noto‘g‘ri javoblarni ko‘rib, boshqa variantlar nega xato ekanini tushuntiraman.

examples.en: A clear study log helps me measure improvement from one week to the next.
examples.uz: Aniq o‘quv kundaligi haftadan haftaga rivojlanishimni o‘lchashga yordam beradi.

examples.en: My speaking practice includes unfamiliar topics, not just rehearsed introductions.
examples.uz: Gapirish mashqim faqat yodlangan kirishlardan emas, notanish mavzulardan ham iborat.

examples.en: After four weeks I will repeat the same type of diagnostic tasks.
examples.uz: To‘rt haftadan so‘ng xuddi shu turdagi diagnostik mashqlarni qayta bajaraman.

examples.en: The tutor suggested separate strategies for vocabulary, timing and coherence.
examples.uz: Ustoz lug‘at, vaqt taqsimoti va izchillik uchun alohida usullarni tavsiya qildi.

examples.en: I will compare my baseline and final results using the same criteria.
examples.uz: Dastlabki va yakuniy natijalarimni bir xil mezonlar bilan solishtiraman.

examples.en: I need a balanced plan that addresses weakness without ignoring my strengths.
examples.uz: Kuchli tomonlarimni unutmasdan kamchiliklarimni tuzatadigan muvozanatli reja kerak.

model.en: I initially wrote Friday, but the speaker corrected the booking to Monday. The later statement is the final answer, so Monday is the date to record.

pitfall.en: Do not choose the first number or date you hear without checking whether it changes.

content.en: During a university library orientation, the guide says that the research desk moves to the second floor on Thursday. Students may borrow laptops for two hours, but they must return them before closing time. Kamola hears the word Tuesday in a question, yet the announcement actually says Thursday. She checks the whole statement before choosing an answer.
content.uz: Universitet kutubxonasini tanishtirish paytida yo‘riqchi tadqiqot bo‘limi payshanba kuni ikkinchi qavatga ko‘chishini aytadi. Talabalar noutbuklarni ikki soatga olishi mumkin, ammo yopilishdan oldin qaytarishlari shart. Kamola savolda seshanba so‘zini ko‘radi, lekin e’londa aslida payshanba deyiladi. U javob berishdan oldin butun gapni tekshiradi.

examples.en: The caller initially booked Friday but later changed the appointment to Monday.

examples.en: The lecturer mentioned the old fee before confirming the revised price.
examples.uz: Ma’ruzachi yangi narxni tasdiqlashdan oldin eski to‘lovni aytdi.

examples.en: I checked whether the answer required a street name or a building number.
examples.uz: Javob uchun ko‘cha nomimi yoki bino raqamimi kerakligini tekshirdim.

examples.en: A plural ending can change whether an answer is accepted.
examples.uz: Ko‘plik qo‘shimchasi javobning to‘g‘ri hisoblanishiga ta’sir qilishi mumkin.

examples.en: The speaker spelled her surname because the receptionist had written it incorrectly.
examples.uz: Qabulxona xodimi familiyani noto‘g‘ri yozgani uchun ayol uni harflab aytdi.

examples.en: I predicted that the next blank might require a date rather than a place.
examples.uz: Keyingi bo‘sh joyga joy emas, sana kerak bo‘lishi mumkinligini taxmin qildim.

examples.en: The recording explained the route change after an unexpected road closure.
examples.uz: Audio kutilmagan yo‘l yopilishidan keyingi yo‘nalish o‘zgarishini tushuntirdi.

examples.en: Students discussed two research options before agreeing on one method.
examples.uz: Talabalar bitta usulni tanlashdan oldin ikkita tadqiqot variantini muhokama qilishdi.

examples.en: I missed the second figure because I was still writing the first answer.
examples.uz: Birinchi javobni yozayotganim sababli ikkinchi raqamni eshitmay qoldim.

examples.en: The map question depended on the words opposite and beyond.
examples.uz: Xarita savolida opposite va beyond so‘zlarini tushunish muhim edi.

examples.en: I checked the exact word limit before entering the answer.
examples.uz: Javobni yozishdan oldin aniq so‘z chegarasini tekshirdim.

examples.en: The correct answer appeared after a correction, not in the speaker’s first sentence.
examples.uz: To‘g‘ri javob so‘zlovchining birinchi gapida emas, tuzatishidan keyin aytildi.

model.en: The paragraph claims that the new method saves energy. It gives an example from one factory, but says nothing about all factories. Therefore a statement about every factory is NOT GIVEN.

content.en: Researchers studying water use in the Fergana Valley compare two irrigation methods. One approach sends water through open channels; the other supplies it directly to plant roots. The article explains that a method which saves water on one farm may require a high initial investment on another. A good reader must separate the main claim from this limitation.
content.uz: Farg‘ona vodiysida suvdan foydalanishni o‘rganayotgan tadqiqotchilar ikki sug‘orish usulini taqqoslaydi. Birinchi usulda suv ochiq ariqlar orqali, ikkinchisida esa o‘simlik ildiziga bevosita yetkaziladi. Maqolada bir xo‘jalikda suvni tejaydigan usul boshqasida katta boshlang‘ich xarajat talab qilishi mumkinligi tushuntiriladi. O‘quvchi asosiy fikrni shu cheklovdan ajratishi kerak.

objectivesEn: Understand the writing task 1 skill and its IELTS task requirements.
Learn 26 topic-specific expressions with accurate Uzbek translations.

12 ta yangi inglizcha-o‘zbekcha namunaviy gapni o‘rganing va audio bilan mashq qiling.
Grammatik izohni yangi javobda qo‘llang; namuna va keng tarqalgan xatoni ko‘rib chiqing.
Sakkizta test, og‘zaki mashqlar va yo‘naltirilgan yozma vazifani bajaring.

content.en: Your task in “Writing Task 1” is to recognise when “trend” is useful. Read the task conditions, practise the specific IELTS skill, and justify answers with the evidence in this unit. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Yozish: 1-topshiriq” darsida “yo‘nalish” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Topshiriq shartini o‘qing, shu IELTS ko‘nikmasini mashq qiling va javoblarni matndagi dalil bilan asoslang. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.
content.modelEn: A practice bar chart compares bicycle use in three fictional university districts in 2015 and 2025.
content.modelUz: Mashq uchun berilgan ustunli diagrammada uchta xayoliy universitet hududida velosipeddan foydalanish 2015 va 2025-yillarda taqqoslangan.

grammar.en: Use by for the size of a change and to for its final value: rose by ten units versus rose to forty units.
grammar.uz: O‘zgarish miqdori uchun by, yakuniy qiymati uchun to ishlating: rose by ten units va rose to forty units.

task.en: Describe one rise, one fall and the largest overall feature in a table or chart; do not invent causes.
task.uz: Jadval yoki grafikdagi bir o‘sish, bir pasayish va eng muhim umumiy xususiyatni tasvirlang; sabablarni o‘ylab topmang.

model.en: Overall, online enrolment became the dominant category. It rose from twenty to forty percent, while classroom attendance declined slightly. The highest online figure was recorded in the final year.
model.uz: Umuman olganda, onlayn ro‘yxatdan o‘tish yetakchi toifaga aylandi. U yigirmadan qirq foizgacha oshdi, sinf qatnashuvi esa biroz kamaydi. Eng yuqori onlayn ko‘rsatkich oxirgi yilda qayd etilgan.

pitfall.en: Do not confuse ten percent with ten percentage points.
pitfall.uz: O‘n foiz bilan o‘n foiz punktini chalkashtirmang.

content.en: A practice bar chart compares bicycle use in three fictional university districts in 2015 and 2025. North increases from 20 to 45 per cent, Central changes from 35 to 40 per cent, and South falls from 30 to 15 per cent. The overview should mention the strongest rise and the only decline without listing every figure in the opening sentence.
content.uz: Mashq uchun berilgan ustunli diagrammada uchta xayoliy universitet hududida velosipeddan foydalanish 2015 va 2025-yillarda taqqoslangan. Shimol 20 foizdan 45 foizga, Markaz 35 foizdan 40 foizga o‘sgan, Janub esa 30 foizdan 15 foizga tushgan. Umumiy xulosada eng katta o‘sish va yagona pasayish aytilishi, birinchi gapda barcha sonlar sanalmasligi kerak.

examples.en: The proportion of students choosing science rose from twenty to thirty percent.
examples.uz: Tabiiy fanlarni tanlagan talabalar ulushi yigirmadan o'ttiz foizgacha oshdi.

examples.en: The highest value was recorded at the end of the reporting period.
examples.uz: Eng yuqori ko‘rsatkich hisobot davrining oxirida qayd etilgan.

examples.en: Online enrolment increased sharply while classroom attendance remained stable.
examples.uz: Onlayn ro‘yxatdan o‘tish keskin oshdi, sinfdagi qatnashuv esa o‘zgarmadi.

examples.en: The smallest category accounted for less than one tenth of the total.
examples.uz: Eng kichik toifa umumiy miqdorning o‘ndan biridan kamini tashkil etdi.

examples.en: I wrote an overview that described the two most important trends.
examples.uz: Ikki eng muhim tendensiyani ifodalagan umumiy xulosa yozdim.

examples.en: The figures fluctuated slightly before reaching a new peak.
examples.uz: Ko‘rsatkichlar yangi cho‘qqiga yetguncha biroz tebrandi.

examples.en: The increase was five percentage points, not five percent of the original value.
examples.uz: O‘sish dastlabki qiymatning besh foizi emas, besh foiz punktini tashkil etdi.

examples.en: A comparison should name both groups and the relevant time period.
examples.uz: Taqqoslashda ikkala guruh hamda tegishli vaqt davri ko‘rsatilishi kerak.

examples.en: I avoided guessing the reasons for changes that the chart did not explain.
examples.uz: Diagramma tushuntirmagan o‘zgarishlar sababini taxmin qilishdan saqlandim.

examples.en: The number of commuters doubled between the first and last years.
examples.uz: Yo‘lovchilar soni birinchi va oxirgi yil oralig‘ida ikki baravar oshdi.

examples.en: The table shows differences in spending across three age groups.
examples.uz: Jadval uch yosh guruhining xarajatlaridagi farqlarni ko‘rsatadi.

examples.en: I checked whether each percentage referred to people, households or purchases.
examples.uz: Har bir foiz odamlarga, uy xo‘jaliklariga yoki xaridlarga tegishliligini tekshirdim.

task.en: Write a position statement, supporting reason, counterargument and rebuttal on city transport investment.
task.uz: Shahar transportiga sarmoya mavzusida pozitsiya, dalil, qarshi fikr va unga javob yozing.

model.en: I support more investment in public transport because it can reduce congestion. Critics worry about initial costs. However, cleaner and more reliable travel can create long-term savings, so the policy remains worthwhile.
model.uz: Tirbandlikni kamaytirishi mumkinligi sababli jamoat transportiga ko‘proq sarmoyani qo‘llab-quvvatlayman. Tanqidchilar dastlabki xarajatlardan xavotirda. Biroq tozaroq va ishonchliroq qatnov uzoq muddatda tejashga olib kelishi mumkin, shuning uchun siyosat foydali.

pitfall.en: Avoid a list of unrelated examples with no clear argument.
pitfall.uz: Aniq dalilsiz aloqasiz misollar ro‘yxatidan qoching.

content.en: A city is considering whether to replace some car parking spaces with a dedicated bus lane. Supporters expect faster journeys and cleaner air; opponents worry that deliveries to small shops will become difficult. A strong essay answers the actual question, compares likely benefits with costs, and explains what conditions would make the proposed change sensible.
content.uz: Shahar ayrim avtomobil turargohlarini alohida avtobus yo‘lagiga aylantirishni ko‘rib chiqmoqda. Qo‘llab-quvvatlovchilar qatnov tezlashishi va havo tozalashini kutadi, qarshilar esa kichik do‘konlarga yuk yetkazish qiyinlashishidan xavotirda. Kuchli insho savolga bevosita javob beradi, foyda va xarajatlarni solishtiradi hamda taklif qaysi sharoitda ma’qul bo‘lishini tushuntiradi.

examples.en: The essay argues that better public transport can reduce urban congestion.

examples.en: The problem has economic consequences as well as social effects.
examples.uz: Muammoning ijtimoiy ta’sirlari bilan birga iqtisodiy oqibatlari ham bor.

examples.uz: Muvozanatli xatboshi e’tirozni rad etishdan oldin uni tan oladi.

examples.en: The solution is practical only if local authorities can fund it.
examples.uz: Mahalliy hokimiyat mablag‘ ajrata olsagina yechim amaliy bo‘ladi.

examples.en: I used precise examples instead of broad claims about modern society.
examples.uz: Zamonaviy jamiyat haqidagi umumiy da’volar o‘rniga aniq misollar keltirdim.

writingTask.en: Write a position statement, supporting reason, counterargument and rebuttal on city transport investment.
writingTask.uz: Shahar transportiga sarmoya mavzusida pozitsiya, dalil, qarshi fikr va unga javob yozing.
writingTask.modelEn: I support more investment in public transport because it can reduce congestion. Critics worry about initial costs. However, cleaner and more reliable travel can create long-term savings, so the policy remains worthwhile.
writingTask.modelUz: Tirbandlikni kamaytirishi mumkinligi sababli jamoat transportiga ko‘proq sarmoyani qo‘llab-quvvatlayman. Tanqidchilar dastlabki xarajatlardan xavotirda. Biroq tozaroq va ishonchliroq qatnov uzoq muddatda tejashga olib kelishi mumkin, shuning uchun siyosat foydali.

Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Gapirish: 1–3-qismlar” darsida “kengaytirmoq” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Topshiriq shartini o‘qing, shu IELTS ko‘nikmasini mashq qiling va javoblarni matndagi dalil bilan asoslang. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.

grammar.en: Extend answers with because, for example and as a result; vary sentence structures instead of forcing memorised phrases.
grammar.uz: Javoblarni because, for example va as a result bilan kengaytiring; yodlangan iboralarni majburan ishlatmay, gap tuzilishini o‘zgartiring.

task.en: Speak for one minute about a useful experience, then explain why similar experiences matter to other people.
task.uz: Foydali tajribangiz haqida bir daqiqa gapiring, so‘ng bunday tajribalar boshqalar uchun nega muhimligini tushuntiring.

model.en: A community project taught me to organise volunteers. At first I found it difficult to delegate tasks, but after a few meetings I became more confident. Similar experiences can help young people develop responsibility.
model.uz: Mahalla loyihasi menga ko‘ngillilarni tashkil etishni o‘rgatdi. Dastlab vazifalarni taqsimlash qiyin edi, ammo bir necha uchrashuvdan keyin ishonchim oshdi. Shunga o‘xshash tajribalar yoshlarning mas’uliyatini rivojlantirishi mumkin.

pitfall.en: A perfect transcript is not evidence of an IELTS speaking band score.
pitfall.uz: Matnning to‘g‘ri tanilishi IELTS gapirish baliga dalil emas.

content.en: An IELTS speaking examiner asks Dilshod about a place where he studies, then invites him to describe a memorable class project. In the longer discussion, the topic changes to whether universities should require practical work. Dilshod moves from a personal example to a general opinion, gives a reason, and responds naturally when the examiner asks why.
content.uz: IELTS gapirish sinovida imtihon oluvchi Dilshoddan qayerda o‘qishini so‘raydi, keyin esda qolgan guruh loyihasini tasvirlashni taklif etadi. Keyingi suhbatda universitetlarda amaliy ish majburiy bo‘lishi kerakmi degan savol qo‘yiladi. Dilshod shaxsiy misoldan umumiy fikrga o‘tadi, sabab keltiradi va nima uchun degan savolga tabiiy javob beradi.

examples.en: I prefer studying in the morning because I can concentrate more easily.
examples.uz: Ertalab o‘qishni afzal ko‘raman, chunki diqqatimni osonroq jamlayman.

examples.en: Last summer I visited a historical city that changed my view of travel.
examples.uz: O‘tgan yozda sayohat haqidagi qarashimni o‘zgartirgan tarixiy shaharga bordim.

examples.en: The experience taught me how to plan under unexpected pressure.
examples.uz: Bu tajriba kutilmagan bosim ostida rejalashni o‘rgatdi.

examples.en: I would choose that course again because the teacher encouraged discussion.
examples.uz: O‘qituvchi munozarani rag‘batlantirgani uchun o‘sha kursni yana tanlardim.

examples.en: A useful example is the community library near my childhood home.
examples.uz: Bolaligimdagi uyimiz yaqinidagi jamoat kutubxonasi bunga yaxshi misol.

examples.en: In my opinion, flexible working hours benefit families with young children.
examples.uz: Fikrimcha, moslashuvchan ish vaqti yosh bolali oilalarga foyda keltiradi.

examples.en: One reason for this change is the growing availability of online services.
examples.uz: Bu o‘zgarishning sabablaridan biri onlayn xizmatlar ko‘payayotganidir.

examples.en: The biggest challenge was explaining my idea without using a memorised script.
examples.uz: Eng katta qiyinchilik fikrimni yodlangan matnsiz tushuntirish edi.

examples.en: If the same situation happened again, I would ask for guidance earlier.
examples.uz: Xuddi shu vaziyat takrorlansa, avvalroq maslahat so‘rardim.

examples.en: The long-term effect could be a stronger connection between local communities.
examples.uz: Uzoq muddatli natija mahallalar o‘rtasida mustahkamroq aloqa bo‘lishi mumkin.

examples.en: I corrected my tense and continued speaking instead of stopping completely.
examples.uz: Zamondagi xatomni tuzatib, butunlay to‘xtash o‘rniga gapirishda davom etdim.

examples.en: My answer contains a personal detail, a reason and an illustrative example.
examples.uz: Javobim shaxsiy tafsilot, sabab va tushunarli misolni o‘z ichiga oladi.

lesson.titleEn: Timed skill practice (not a full mock) · IELTS Academic
objectivesEn: Understand the timed skill practice (not a full mock) skill and its IELTS task requirements.
Learn 25 topic-specific expressions with accurate Uzbek translations.
Study 12 original bilingual model sentences and use the audio to practise natural expression.
Apply the grammar note to a new response; review a worked example and common pitfall.
Complete eight self-check questions, original speech drills and a guided written task.
objectivesUz: “Vaqtli ko‘nikma mashqi” bo‘yicha IELTS topshirig‘i va ko‘nikmasini tushuning.
25 ta mavzuga oid iborani aniq o‘zbekcha tarjimalari bilan o‘rganing.
12 ta yangi inglizcha-o‘zbekcha namunaviy gapni o‘rganing va audio bilan mashq qiling.
Grammatik izohni yangi javobda qo‘llang; namuna va keng tarqalgan xatoni ko‘rib chiqing.
Sakkizta test, og‘zaki mashqlar va yo‘naltirilgan yozma vazifani bajaring.

content.headingEn: Understand the skill: Timed skill practice (not a full mock)
content.en: Your task in “Timed skill practice (not a full mock)” is to recognise when “mock test” is useful. Read the task conditions, practise the specific IELTS skill, and justify answers with the evidence in this unit. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Vaqtli ko‘nikma mashqi” darsida “sinov testi” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Topshiriq shartini o‘qing, shu IELTS ko‘nikmasini mashq qiling va javoblarni matndagi dalil bilan asoslang. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.
content.modelEn: An academic candidate completes a short timed practice block, not a full IELTS mock test.
content.modelUz: Academic yo‘nalishidagi o‘quvchi to‘liq IELTS sinovi emas, balki qisqa vaqtli mashq bajaradi.

grammar.en: Use conditionals to explain time choices: If I cannot locate the evidence quickly, I will return later.
grammar.uz: Vaqt qarorlarini ifodalashda shart gaplardan foydalaning: If I cannot locate the evidence quickly, I will return later.

task.en: Run a short reading section with a timer; document two timing decisions and one correction.
task.uz: Qisqa o‘qish bo‘limini taymer bilan bajaring; ikki vaqt qarorini va bitta tuzatishni qayd eting.

model.en: I skipped the longest question and returned after finishing easier items. This saved time, but I still made one spelling error. Next time I will reserve two minutes for checking.
model.uz: Eng uzun savolni vaqtincha o‘tkazib, osonlarini tugatgach qaytdim. Bu vaqtni tejadi, lekin bitta imlo xatosi qildim. Keyingi safar tekshirishga ikki daqiqa qoldiraman.

pitfall.en: Timed practice is not a full IELTS mock unless it includes every required section and task.
pitfall.uz: Vaqtli mashq barcha zarur bo‘lim va topshiriqlarni o‘z ichiga olmasa, to‘liq IELTS sinovi emas.

content.headingEn: Case study: Timed skill practice (not a full mock)
content.en: An academic candidate completes a short timed practice block, not a full IELTS mock test. She spends six minutes outlining an argument, eight minutes writing one body paragraph, and four minutes checking topic relevance and grammar. Her review records whether evidence supports the point rather than treating speed alone as success.
content.uz: Academic yo‘nalishidagi o‘quvchi to‘liq IELTS sinovi emas, balki qisqa vaqtli mashq bajaradi. U olti daqiqa dalil rejasini tuzadi, sakkiz daqiqa bitta asosiy xatboshi yozadi va to‘rt daqiqa mavzuga moslik hamda grammatikani tekshiradi. Uning tahlilida faqat tezlik emas, dalilning fikrni qo‘llab-quvvatlashi baholanadi.

examples.en: I divided the practice session into sections with separate time limits.
examples.uz: Mashqni alohida vaqt cheklovlari bo‘lgan bo‘limlarga ajratdim.

examples.en: A difficult reading question should not consume the time needed for the final passage.
examples.uz: Qiyin o‘qish savoli oxirgi matnga kerakli vaqtni egallab olmasligi kerak.

examples.en: I marked uncertain answers and returned to them when time remained.
examples.uz: Noaniq javoblarni belgilab, vaqt qolganida ularga qaytdim.

examples.en: The essay needed more planning time than I had originally allowed.
examples.uz: Inshoga avval rejalaganimdan ko‘proq tayyorgarlik vaqti kerak bo‘ldi.

examples.en: After the timed drill I identified which mistakes came from rushing.
examples.uz: Vaqtli mashqdan so‘ng qaysi xatolar shoshilishdan kelib chiqqanini aniqladim.

examples.en: The final check revealed two spelling mistakes in otherwise correct answers.
examples.uz: Yakuniy tekshiruv boshqa jihatdan to‘g‘ri javoblardagi ikkita imlo xatosini ko‘rsatdi.

examples.en: I practised under realistic conditions but did not treat it as a full official mock.
examples.uz: Haqiqiyga yaqin sharoitda mashq qildim, ammo buni to‘liq rasmiy sinov deb hisoblamadim.

examples.en: Short breaks between study sessions helped me maintain concentration.
examples.uz: Mashg‘ulotlar orasidagi qisqa tanaffuslar diqqatni saqlashimga yordam berdi.

examples.en: I should answer every question even when I need to make an educated guess.
examples.uz: Asosli taxmin qilishim kerak bo‘lsa ham barcha savollarga javob berishim lozim.

examples.en: The review log showed that vocabulary was not my main weakness.
examples.uz: Tahlil daftarim lug‘at eng katta kamchiligim emasligini ko‘rsatdi.

examples.en: I updated next week’s plan using evidence from the timed results.
examples.uz: Keyingi haftaning rejasini vaqtli mashq natijalariga tayangan holda yangiladim.

examples.en: Accurate answers matter more than simply finishing early.
examples.uz: Erta tugatishdan ko‘ra to‘g‘ri javoblar muhimroq.

lesson.titleEn: Foundation and diagnostic · IELTS General Training
objectivesEn: Understand the foundation and diagnostic skill and its IELTS task requirements.
Learn 24 topic-specific expressions with accurate Uzbek translations.
Study 12 original bilingual model sentences and use the audio to practise natural expression.
Apply the grammar note to a new response; review a worked example and common pitfall.
Complete eight self-check questions, original speech drills and a guided written task.
objectivesUz: “Asoslar va diagnostika” bo‘yicha IELTS topshirig‘i va ko‘nikmasini tushuning.
24 ta mavzuga oid iborani aniq o‘zbekcha tarjimalari bilan o‘rganing.
12 ta yangi inglizcha-o‘zbekcha namunaviy gapni o‘rganing va audio bilan mashq qiling.
Grammatik izohni yangi javobda qo‘llang; namuna va keng tarqalgan xatoni ko‘rib chiqing.
Sakkizta test, og‘zaki mashqlar va yo‘naltirilgan yozma vazifani bajaring.

content.headingEn: Understand the skill: Foundation and diagnostic
content.en: Your task in “Foundation and diagnostic” is to recognise when “band” is useful. Read the task conditions, practise the specific IELTS skill, and justify answers with the evidence in this unit. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Asoslar va diagnostika” darsida “band ball” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Topshiriq shartini o‘qing, shu IELTS ko‘nikmasini mashq qiling va javoblarni matndagi dalil bilan asoslang. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.
content.modelEn: Akmal is preparing for IELTS General Training because he hopes to work abroad.
content.modelUz: Akmal xorijda ishlashni rejalashtirgani uchun IELTS General Training tayyorgarligini boshlaydi.

grammar.en: Use polite questions with could or would when requesting practical information from a service provider.
grammar.uz: Xizmat ko‘rsatuvchidan amaliy ma’lumot so‘raganda could yoki would bilan muloyim savollar tuzing.

task.en: Write a short enquiry about an evening course, including two questions and your preferred contact method.
task.uz: Kechki kurs haqida ikki savol va afzal aloqa usulingizni kiritib qisqa so‘rov yozing.

model.en: I am interested in your evening English classes. Could you confirm the start date and the total fee? I would prefer to receive the details by email because I work during the day.
model.uz: Kechki ingliz tili darslaringizga qiziqaman. Boshlanish sanasi va umumiy to‘lovni tasdiqlab bera olasizmi? Kunduzi ishlaganim uchun ma’lumotni elektron pochta orqali olishni afzal ko‘raman.

pitfall.en: General Training reading and writing tasks differ from Academic, although both share the same listening and speaking tests.
pitfall.uz: General Training ning o‘qish va yozish topshiriqlari Academic dan farq qiladi, ammo tinglash va gapirish bir xil.

content.en: Akmal is preparing for IELTS General Training because he hopes to work abroad. His diagnostic practice shows that he can follow a workplace notice but struggles to organise a formal letter about a housing problem. He chooses to practise identifying the reader, purpose and required action before worrying about advanced vocabulary.
content.uz: Akmal xorijda ishlashni rejalashtirgani uchun IELTS General Training tayyorgarligini boshlaydi. Dastlabki mashqda u ish joyidagi e’lonni tushunadi, lekin uy-joy muammosi haqida rasmiy xatni tartibga solishda qiynaladi. U murakkab so‘zlardan oldin xat oluvchi, maqsad va talab qilinadigan harakatni aniqlashni mashq qiladi.

examples.en: I want to improve the English I use at work and in everyday services.
examples.uz: Men ishda va kundalik xizmatlarda ishlatadigan ingliz tilimni yaxshilamoqchiman.

examples.en: The diagnostic showed that I understand notices better than spoken instructions.
examples.uz: Diagnostika e’lonlarni og‘zaki ko‘rsatmalardan yaxshiroq tushunishimni ko‘rsatdi.

examples.uz: Qisqa norasmiy xabar yoza olaman, ammo rasmiy xatlarni mashq qilishim kerak.

examples.uz: Maqsadim uchrashuvlarni boshqa birovdan tarjima so‘ramasdan hal qilishdir.

examples.en: The reading task included a timetable and a workplace safety notice.
examples.uz: O‘qish topshirig‘ida jadval va ish joyi xavfsizligi e’loni bor edi.

examples.en: I reviewed the words that appeared in the rental agreement.
examples.uz: Ijara shartnomasida uchragan so‘zlarni takrorladim.

examples.en: Accurate details matter when completing a job application form.
examples.uz: Ishga kirish arizasini to‘ldirishda aniq ma’lumotlar muhim.

examples.en: After the first week I could describe my daily routine more confidently.
examples.uz: Birinchi haftadan so‘ng kun tartibimni ishonchliroq tasvirlay oldim.

examples.en: The course includes both familiar social situations and workplace communication.
examples.uz: Kurs tanish ijtimoiy vaziyatlarni ham, ishdagi muloqotni ham qamrab oladi.

examples.en: I keep a list of practical mistakes that cause misunderstandings.
examples.uz: Tushunmovchilik keltiradigan amaliy xatolarim ro‘yxatini yuritaman.

examples.en: My target is steady progress rather than memorising long answers.
examples.uz: Maqsadim uzun javoblarni yodlash emas, izchil rivojlanishdir.

examples.en: I will repeat this baseline task after four focused study weeks.
examples.uz: To‘rt haftalik maqsadli o‘qishdan so‘ng ushbu dastlabki mashqni takrorlayman.

content.en: Your task in “Listening” is to recognise when “speaker” is useful. Read the task conditions, practise the specific IELTS skill, and justify answers with the evidence in this unit. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Tinglab tushunish” darsida “so‘zlovchi” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Topshiriq shartini o‘qing, shu IELTS ko‘nikmasini mashq qiling va javoblarni matndagi dalil bilan asoslang. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.

content.en: At Tashkent railway station, an announcement says that the 14:20 service to Bukhara will leave from platform four instead of platform two. Passengers who need assistance should speak to an employee near the ticket office. Aziz first writes the old platform from his ticket, then corrects his note after hearing the new announcement.

task.en: Compare two workplace notices and state one compulsory action, one optional action and an application deadline.

model.en: Staff must complete safety training before entering the workshop. Experienced employees may apply for the supervisor course. Applications close on the final Friday of the month.

content.en: A staff notice at a distribution centre explains the new weekend rota. Employees who volunteer before Wednesday receive confirmation by Friday; anyone unable to attend must contact the supervisor directly rather than leave a message in the group chat. The reading task asks learners to distinguish compulsory instructions from optional choices.
content.uz: Ta’minot markazidagi e’londa yangi dam olish kunlari ish jadvali tushuntiriladi. Chorshanbagacha ko‘ngilli bo‘lgan xodimlar juma kuni tasdiq oladi; kela olmaydiganlar guruh chatiga yozish o‘rniga rahbarga bevosita xabar berishi shart. O‘qish mashqi majburiy ko‘rsatmalarni ixtiyoriy tanlovlardan ajratishni talab qiladi.

content.en: Your task in “Writing Task 1” is to recognise when “increase” is useful. Read the task conditions, practise the specific IELTS skill, and justify answers with the evidence in this unit. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Yozish: 1-topshiriq” darsida “o‘sish” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Topshiriq shartini o‘qing, shu IELTS ko‘nikmasini mashq qiling va javoblarni matndagi dalil bilan asoslang. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.

grammar.en: Formal letters use complete sentences with polite conditionals: I would appreciate it if you could...
grammar.uz: Rasmiy xatlarda muloyim shartli tuzilmalar bilan to‘liq gaplar ishlatiladi: I would appreciate it if you could...

task.en: Write a formal service request covering the reason, relevant background and expected action.
task.uz: Sabab, zarur ma’lumot va kutilgan harakatni qamrab olgan rasmiy xizmat so‘rovi yozing.

model.en: I am writing to request a repair appointment because the heating system has stopped working. The fault began on Tuesday and affects two rooms. I would appreciate it if you could arrange an inspection this week.
model.uz: Isitish tizimi ishlamay qolgani sababli ta’mirlash uchrashuvini so‘rab yozyapman. Nosozlik seshanba kuni boshlangan va ikki xonaga ta’sir qilmoqda. Shu hafta tekshiruvni tashkil etsangiz minnatdor bo‘lardim.

pitfall.en: Avoid slang, missing bullet points and abrupt commands in a formal letter.
pitfall.uz: Rasmiy xatda jargon, tushib qolgan bandlar va qo‘pol buyruqlardan saqlaning.

content.en: A tenant writes to a building manager because the heating fails every evening. The letter must describe when the fault started, explain its effect on the household, and request a reasonable repair date. The tone is firm but courteous; a threat or an unrelated life story would not help the manager resolve the problem.
content.uz: Ijarachi har oqshom isitish ishlamay qolgani uchun bino boshqaruvchisiga yozadi. Xatda nosozlik qachon boshlanganini aytish, uning oilaga ta’sirini tushuntirish va ta’mirlashning maqbul muddatini so‘rash kerak. Uslub qat’iy, ammo xushmuomala bo‘lishi lozim; tahdid yoki mavzuga aloqasiz hikoya muammoni hal qilishga yordam bermaydi.

examples.uz: Yaqinda binoga ko‘chib keldim va avtoturargoh uchun ro‘yxatdan o‘tmoqchiman.

examples.en: Could you please confirm whether the service is available on weekends?
examples.uz: Xizmat dam olish kunlari ishlashini tasdiqlab bera olasizmi?

examples.en: I would appreciate a written reply by the end of next week.
examples.uz: Kelasi hafta oxirigacha yozma javob bersangiz minnatdor bo‘lardim.

examples.en: Please find the requested documents attached to this letter.
examples.uz: So‘ralgan hujjatlar ushbu xatga ilova qilingan.

examples.en: I apologise for the inconvenience caused by the earlier misunderstanding.
examples.uz: Avvalgi tushunmovchilik keltirgan noqulaylik uchun uzr so‘rayman.

examples.en: I am concerned that the heating has not worked properly for several days.
examples.uz: Isitish bir necha kundan beri to‘g‘ri ishlamayotganidan xavotirdaman.

examples.en: I would be grateful if a technician could inspect the system this week.
examples.uz: Shu hafta mutaxassis tizimni tekshirsa minnatdor bo‘lardim.

examples.en: The letter should explain the reason for contact before giving extra details.
examples.uz: Xatda qo‘shimcha ma’lumotlardan oldin murojaat sababi tushuntirilishi kerak.

examples.en: I checked that all three requested points were covered in separate paragraphs.
examples.uz: So‘ralgan uch bandning hammasi alohida xatboshilarda yoritilganini tekshirdim.

examples.en: The closing sentence politely invites the reader to contact me.
examples.uz: Yakuniy jumla o‘quvchini men bilan muloyim tarzda bog‘lanishga undaydi.

examples.en: My tone remains formal because I do not know the recipient personally.
examples.uz: Qabul qiluvchini shaxsan tanimaganim uchun ohangim rasmiy bo‘lib qoladi.

model.en: Affordable homes can help workers remain close to employment. However, new developments require investment in transport and services. Authorities should consider housing and infrastructure together rather than separately.

content.en: Some employers allow staff to choose flexible working hours, while others insist on a fixed schedule. Flexibility can help parents and commuters, but coordinated services may require everyone to be available at the same time. A General Training essay should discuss the competing needs and defend a clear position with practical examples.
content.uz: Ba’zi ish beruvchilar xodimlarga moslashuvchan ish soatini tanlashga ruxsat beradi, boshqalari qat’iy jadval talab qiladi. Moslashuvchanlik ota-onalar va qatnovchilarga yordam berishi mumkin, biroq umumiy xizmatlar hammaning bir vaqtda ishlashini talab qilishi mumkin. General Training inshosida qarama-qarshi ehtiyojlar muhokama qilinib, aniq fikr amaliy misollar bilan himoya qilinadi.

examples.en: The conclusion recommends a balanced approach without repeating the introduction.
examples.uz: Xulosa kirishni takrorlamasdan muvozanatli yondashuvni tavsiya qiladi.

examples.en: The writer supports the opinion with evidence rather than personal slogans.
examples.uz: Muallif fikrini shiorlar emas, dalillar bilan qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi.

examples.uz: Jamoat xizmatlari keksa yashovchilarning hayot sifatini yaxshilashi mumkin.

content.en: For a speaking exercise, Shirin describes a neighbour who helped organise a community event. She explains what the person did, how other residents responded, and why the experience mattered to her. A follow-up question asks whether communities depend more on local volunteers or professional services, so she must move beyond memorised facts.
content.uz: Gapirish mashqida Shirin mahalla tadbirini tashkil etishga yordam bergan qo‘shnisini tasvirlaydi. U qo‘shni nima qilganini, boshqalar qanday munosabat bildirganini va bu voqea nima uchun muhimligini tushuntiradi. Qo‘shimcha savolda jamoaga ko‘proq ko‘ngillilar kerakmi yoki professional xizmatlar kerakmi deb so‘raladi, shu sabab yodlangan faktlar yetarli emas.

examples.en: My favourite local market is busy because it serves several nearby districts.

examples.uz: Kutilmagan narsani o‘rganganim uchun bu tajriba esda qolarli bo‘ldi.

examples.uz: Ob-havo yaxshi bo‘lsa ishga piyoda borishni afzal ko‘raman.

examples.uz: Suhbatdosh bu an’ana yoshlar uchun nega hanuz muhimligini so‘radi.

examples.uz: Mahallaning afzalliklaridan biri qulay jamoat transportidir.

examples.uz: Bir narsani o‘zgartira olsam, kattaroq jamoat kutubxonasi qurar edim.

examples.en: My story begins with a journey and ends with a useful lesson.
examples.uz: Hikoyam safardan boshlanib, foydali saboq bilan tugaydi.

examples.uz: Voqea qarindoshlarim bilan munosabatimga qanday ta’sir qilganini tushuntirdim.

lesson.titleEn: Timed skill practice (not a full mock) · IELTS General Training
objectivesEn: Understand the timed skill practice (not a full mock) skill and its IELTS task requirements.
Learn 25 topic-specific expressions with accurate Uzbek translations.
Study 12 original bilingual model sentences and use the audio to practise natural expression.
Apply the grammar note to a new response; review a worked example and common pitfall.
Complete eight self-check questions, original speech drills and a guided written task.
objectivesUz: “Vaqtli ko‘nikma mashqi” bo‘yicha IELTS topshirig‘i va ko‘nikmasini tushuning.
25 ta mavzuga oid iborani aniq o‘zbekcha tarjimalari bilan o‘rganing.
12 ta yangi inglizcha-o‘zbekcha namunaviy gapni o‘rganing va audio bilan mashq qiling.
Grammatik izohni yangi javobda qo‘llang; namuna va keng tarqalgan xatoni ko‘rib chiqing.
Sakkizta test, og‘zaki mashqlar va yo‘naltirilgan yozma vazifani bajaring.

content.headingEn: Understand the skill: Timed skill practice (not a full mock)
content.en: Your task in “Timed skill practice (not a full mock)” is to recognise when “timer” is useful. Read the task conditions, practise the specific IELTS skill, and justify answers with the evidence in this unit. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Vaqtli ko‘nikma mashqi” darsida “vaqt o‘lchagich” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Topshiriq shartini o‘qing, shu IELTS ko‘nikmasini mashq qiling va javoblarni matndagi dalil bilan asoslang. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.
content.modelEn: For an eighteen-minute practice session, an applicant reads a short public notice and drafts the opening of a formal request letter.
content.modelUz: O‘n sakkiz daqiqalik mashqda o‘quvchi qisqa ommaviy e’lonni o‘qib, rasmiy so‘rov xatining kirish qismini yozadi.

grammar.en: Time clauses with before and after clarify the order of actions: review questions before the recording begins.
grammar.uz: Before va after bilan tuzilgan vaqt gaplari amallar ketma-ketligini aniqlaydi: review questions before the recording begins.

task.en: Write your timing plan for a short reading and writing study session, then record where you lost time.
task.uz: Qisqa o‘qish va yozish mashg‘uloti uchun vaqt rejasi tuzing, so‘ng vaqt qayerda ketganini qayd eting.

model.en: I allocated twenty minutes to the reading exercise and thirty minutes to writing. I finished reading early but spent too long revising the introduction. Next time I will limit planning and keep more time for proofreading.
model.uz: O‘qishga yigirma, yozishga o'ttiz daqiqa ajratdim. O‘qishni erta tugatdim, ammo kirishni tuzatishga ko‘p vaqt sarfladim. Keyingi safar rejalashni cheklab, tekshirishga ko‘proq vaqt qoldiraman.

pitfall.en: A short timed drill must not be advertised as a full official IELTS mock test.
pitfall.uz: Qisqa vaqtli mashq to‘liq rasmiy IELTS sinovi sifatida ko‘rsatilmasligi kerak.

content.headingEn: Case study: Timed skill practice (not a full mock)
content.en: For an eighteen-minute practice session, an applicant reads a short public notice and drafts the opening of a formal request letter. The learner then checks whether the requested information appears explicitly in the notice and whether the letter addresses the correct reader. This is a targeted drill, not a complete General Training examination.
content.uz: O‘n sakkiz daqiqalik mashqda o‘quvchi qisqa ommaviy e’lonni o‘qib, rasmiy so‘rov xatining kirish qismini yozadi. Keyin kerakli ma’lumot e’londa aniq berilganmi va xat to‘g‘ri oluvchiga murojaat qilganmi, tekshiradi. Bu to‘liq General Training imtihoni emas, maqsadli mashqdir.

content.en: Your task in “Targeted practice” is to recognise when “weak area” is useful. Read the task conditions, practise the specific IELTS skill, and justify answers with the evidence in this unit. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Maqsadli mashqlar” darsida “zaif yo‘nalish” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Topshiriq shartini o‘qing, shu IELTS ko‘nikmasini mashq qiling va javoblarni matndagi dalil bilan asoslang. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.

content.en: A college advertises a short evening computer course. Classes begin on the tenth of November, registration closes three days earlier, and beginners may borrow a laptop in the classroom. The course notice asks applicants to contact the office if they cannot attend the first meeting. Readers must distinguish the start date from the registration deadline.

Birinchi uchrashuvga kela olmaydiganlar ofisga murojaat qilishi kerak. O‘quvchi boshlanish sanasini ro‘yxatdan o‘tish muddatidan ajratishi lozim.

content.en: Umida writes an email to a friend inviting her to visit a new public library. She explains where the building is, mentions a Saturday reading session, and suggests meeting at the entrance at eleven. Before sending the email, she checks that her invitation includes a place, a time and a clear reason for meeting.
content.uz: Umida dugonasini yangi ommaviy kutubxonaga taklif qilib xat yozadi. U bino qayerda ekanini tushuntiradi, shanbadagi o‘qish mashg‘ulotini aytadi va soat o‘n birda kirish joyida uchrashishni taklif qiladi. Xatni yuborishdan avval unda joy, vaqt va uchrashuv sababi borligini tekshiradi.

content.en: During a speaking exercise, Sardor compares studying at home with studying in a group. He says home is quieter, but classmates can explain difficult ideas more quickly. lesson.titleEn: Timed skill check · Uzbekistan Multilevel B1
objectivesEn: Understand the B1 communication task using a scenario specific to this lesson.
Learn 23 distinct expressions with Uzbek translations.
Study 12 bilingual example sentences and practise speaking the first eight aloud.
Apply the grammar focus, complete a guided language challenge and review a worked response.
Complete eight short checks, twelve guided speaking tasks and the 22-question lesson exam.
objectivesUz: Ushbu darsdagi B1 darajasiga mos muloqot vazifasini tushuning.
23 ta turli iborani o‘zbekcha tarjimasi bilan o‘rganing.
12 ta ikki tilli gapni o‘qing va dastlabki sakkiztasini ovoz chiqarib mashq qiling.
Grammatik mavzu, mustaqil topshiriq va namunaviy javobni o‘rganing.
Sakkizta qisqa savol, o‘n ikkita og‘zaki vazifa va 22 savollik dars imtihonini bajaring.

content.en: Your task in “Timed skill check” is to recognise when “focus” is useful. Identify the purpose of the national multilevel practice task and support each response with details from the passage. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Vaqtli ko‘nikma mashqi” darsida “diqqat” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Milliy Multilevel mashqi maqsadini aniqlang va har bir javobni matndagi tafsilotlar bilan asoslang. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.

grammar.en: Use clear past, present and future forms, because, although and first/then/afterwards to connect familiar events. Plan timed responses around task value; preserve enough time to revise facts, structure and language.

12 ta ikki tilli gapni o‘qing va dastlabki sakkiztasini ovoz chiqarib mashq qiling.
Grammatik mavzu, mustaqil topshiriq va namunaviy javobni o‘rganing.

content.en: Your task in “Diagnostic” is to recognise when “vocabulary” is useful. Identify the purpose of the national multilevel practice task and support each response with details from the passage. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Diagnostika” darsida “lug‘at” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Milliy Multilevel mashqi maqsadini aniqlang va har bir javobni matndagi tafsilotlar bilan asoslang. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.

grammar.en: Practise concessions with although/whereas/nevertheless, relative clauses and qualified claims with may or might. Use accurate self-assessment language: say what you can do, what remains difficult, and how you know.
grammar.uz: Although/whereas/nevertheless bilan yon berish, aniqlovchi ergash gaplar hamda may yoki might orqali ehtiyotkor xulosalarni mashq qiling. Dalillarni izchil bog‘lang. Misol, istisno va qarshi fikrni bir-biriga mantiqan bog‘lang.

task.en: Describe a recent learning challenge and propose two measurable improvements.
task.uz: So‘nggi mashqdagi ikki zaif jihatni ayting va rivojlanish uchun o‘lchanadigan maqsad belgilang.

model.en: The diagnostic task revealed that my arguments lacked sufficient evidence.
model.uz: Diagnostik topshiriq dalillarim yetarlicha asoslanmaganini ko‘rsatdi.

pitfall.en: Avoid describing a single practice attempt as a reliable official proficiency result.
pitfall.uz: Bitta urinish natijasidan haqiqiy til darajangiz haqida qat’iy xulosa chiqarmang.

content.headingUz: CEFR B2 mavzu lug‘ati: 22 ta ibora

content.en: A youth organisation surveys two hundred residents about recycling. Half say they would separate household waste if collection points were closer; another group says clear instructions matter more than distance. The report notes that respondents volunteered for the survey, so the findings may not represent every neighbourhood.
content.uz: Yoshlar tashkiloti ikki yuz aholidan chiqindini saralash haqida so‘raydi. Yarmi yig‘ish joylari yaqinroq bo‘lsa chiqindini ajratishini aytadi, boshqa guruh esa aniq ko‘rsatmalar masofadan muhimroq deb hisoblaydi. Hisobotda ishtirokchilar o‘z ixtiyori bilan qatnashgani uchun natijalar barcha mahallani aks ettirmasligi mumkinligi aytiladi.

content.en: At a campus discussion, a transport officer argues that more buses would reduce traffic, while a student representative worries about the cost of new routes. The chair asks both sides to distinguish short-term expenses from long-term benefits. The listening task requires learners to identify each speaker's position rather than combine them into one opinion.
content.uz: Kampusdagi suhbatda transport xodimi avtobuslar ko‘payishi tirbandlikni kamaytirishini aytadi, talabalar vakili esa yangi yo‘nalish xarajatidan xavotir bildiradi. Rais ikkala tomondan qisqa muddatli xarajatni uzoq muddatli foydadan ajratishni so‘raydi. Tinglash mashqi har bir so‘zlovchining pozitsiyasini alohida aniqlashni talab qiladi.

examples.en: The speaker sounded supportive at first but later expressed reservations.
examples.uz: So‘zlovchi avval qo‘llab-quvvatlagandek eshitildi, ammo keyin e’tiroz bildirdi.

examples.en: Although she agreed with the schedule, she questioned the proposed location.
examples.uz: U jadvalga rozi bo‘lsa-da, taklif qilingan joyni shubha ostiga oldi.

examples.en: The phrase might be better suggests a polite alternative rather than an order.
examples.uz: Might be better iborasi buyruq emas, muloyim muqobil taklifni bildiradi.

examples.en: A short pause indicated that the manager was uncertain about the budget.
examples.uz: Qisqa tanaffus rahbar byudjetga ishonchi komil emasligini ko‘rsatdi.

examples.en: We inferred the speaker's intention from both tone and context.
examples.uz: So‘zlovchi niyatini ohang va vaziyatdan kelib chiqib aniqladik.

examples.en: The discussion shifted when a new participant introduced another concern.
examples.uz: Yangi ishtirokchi boshqa xavotirni aytgach, muhokama yo‘nalishi o‘zgardi.

examples.en: She accepted the general principle while rejecting the practical details.
examples.uz: U umumiy tamoyilni qabul qildi, ammo amaliy tafsilotlarni rad etdi.

examples.en: A repeated contrast showed that cost mattered more than convenience.
examples.uz: Takrorlangan qarama-qarshilik xarajat qulaylikdan muhimroq ekanini ko‘rsatdi.

examples.en: Do not confuse a cautious prediction with a definite promise.
examples.uz: Ehtiyotkor bashoratni qat’iy va’da bilan adashtirmang.

examples.en: The final agreement depended on whether the suppliers could deliver early.
examples.uz: Yakuniy kelishuv yetkazib beruvchilar erta yetkaza olishiga bog‘liq edi.

examples.en: We listened again to confirm which objection belonged to which speaker.
examples.uz: Qaysi e’tiroz qaysi so‘zlovchiga tegishli ekanini aniqlash uchun qayta tingladik.

examples.en: The words on paper were positive, yet the voice expressed doubt.
examples.uz: Qog‘ozdagi so‘zlar ijobiy edi, biroq ovoz shubhani ifodaladi.

content.en: An editorial considers whether offices should offer employees two remote-working days per week. Advocates point to shorter commutes and better concentration; critics argue that new employees may lose informal mentoring. The writer concludes that a trial period could reveal which teams benefit most, rather than imposing one rule on everyone.
content.uz: Tahririy maqolada ofis xodimlariga haftasiga ikki kun masofadan ishlashga ruxsat berish masalasi ko‘riladi. Tarafdorlar qatnov qisqarishi va diqqat yaxshilanishini aytadi, tanqidchilar esa yangi xodimlar norasmiy murabbiylikdan ayrilishi mumkinligini ta’kidlaydi. Muallif bir xil qoidadan ko‘ra sinov muddati qaysi jamoaga foyda berishini ko‘rsatadi, deb xulosa qiladi.

content.en: A student prepares an argument about replacing printed textbooks with digital materials. Screens can reduce the weight of school bags and make updates faster, but some families lack reliable devices. The writer proposes shared school tablets while keeping a small printed reserve and explains why a mixed approach may be fairer.
content.uz: Talaba bosma darsliklarni raqamli materiallarga almashtirish haqida dalilli matn yozadi. Ekranlar sumka og‘irligini kamaytirishi va yangilashni tezlatishi mumkin, ammo ayrim oilalarda ishonchli qurilma yo‘q. Muallif maktab planshetlarini birga ishlatish va oz miqdorda bosma kitob saqlashni taklif qilib, aralash usul nima uchun adolatliroq ekanini tushuntiradi.

content.en: For an oral presentation, Sevara proposes extending the community library's evening hours. She gives two reasons: students finish classes late and shift workers currently cannot borrow books. A classmate asks about staffing costs, so Sevara acknowledges the concern and suggests a short pilot rather than promising a permanent change immediately.
content.uz: Og‘zaki taqdimotda Sevara mahalla kutubxonasi ish vaqtini kechqurungacha uzaytirishni taklif qiladi. U ikki sabab keltiradi: talabalar darsdan kech chiqadi, smenali xodimlar esa hozir kitob ola olmaydi. Sinfdoshi xodim xarajatini so‘raganda Sevara tashvishni tan olib, darhol doimiy o‘zgarish o‘rniga qisqa sinovni taklif qiladi.

examples.en: I partly agree with your suggestion, although the cost worries me.
examples.uz: Taklifingizga qisman qo‘shilaman, ammo xarajat meni xavotirga soladi.

examples.en: Could you clarify whether you mean online or classroom learning?

examples.en: One practical advantage is flexibility for students who work.
examples.uz: Amaliy afzalliklardan biri ishlaydigan talabalar uchun moslashuvchanlikdir.

examples.en: However, we should also consider the need for personal interaction.
examples.uz: Biroq shaxsiy muloqot zarurligini ham hisobga olishimiz kerak.

examples.en: Let me give a concrete example from my university experience.
examples.uz: Universitetdagi tajribamdan aniq bir misol keltiray.

examples.en: I understand your point, but the evidence suggests another conclusion.
examples.uz: Fikringizni tushunaman, ammo dalillar boshqa xulosani ko‘rsatadi.

examples.en: Perhaps we could combine both approaches instead of choosing one.
examples.uz: Balki bittasini tanlash o‘rniga ikkala yondashuvni birlashtirarmiz.

examples.en: What effect might this decision have on smaller towns?
examples.uz: Bu qaror kichik shaharlarga qanday ta’sir qilishi mumkin?

examples.en: The discussion became more productive when we explained our assumptions.
examples.uz: Taxminlarimizni tushuntirganimizdan keyin muhokama samaraliroq bo‘ldi.

examples.en: I would distinguish short-term convenience from long-term benefit.
examples.uz: Men qisqa muddatli qulaylikni uzoq muddatli foydadan ajratgan bo‘lardim.

examples.en: To summarise, we agree on the goal but not on the method.
examples.uz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, maqsadda kelishamiz, ammo usulda emas.

examples.uz: Taklif qilgan muqobil variantimni ko‘rib chiqqaningiz uchun rahmat.

lesson.titleEn: Timed skill check · Uzbekistan Multilevel B2
objectivesEn: Understand the B2 communication task using a scenario specific to this lesson.
Learn 22 distinct expressions with Uzbek translations.
Study 12 bilingual example sentences and practise speaking the first eight aloud.
Apply the grammar focus, complete a guided language challenge and review a worked response.
Complete eight short checks, twelve guided speaking tasks and the 22-question lesson exam.
objectivesUz: Ushbu darsdagi B2 darajasiga mos muloqot vazifasini tushuning.
22 ta turli iborani o‘zbekcha tarjimasi bilan o‘rganing.
12 ta ikki tilli gapni o‘qing va dastlabki sakkiztasini ovoz chiqarib mashq qiling.
Grammatik mavzu, mustaqil topshiriq va namunaviy javobni o‘rganing.
Sakkizta qisqa savol, o‘n ikkita og‘zaki vazifa va 22 savollik dars imtihonini bajaring.

content.en: Your task in “Timed skill check” is to recognise when “result” is useful. Identify the purpose of the national multilevel practice task and support each response with details from the passage. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Vaqtli ko‘nikma mashqi” darsida “natija” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Milliy Multilevel mashqi maqsadini aniqlang va har bir javobni matndagi tafsilotlar bilan asoslang. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.
content.modelEn: In a twelve-minute B2 practice block, students examine two short opinions about a bicycle-sharing programme.
content.modelUz: O‘n ikki daqiqalik B2 mashqda talabalar velosiped ijarasi dasturi haqida ikki qisqa fikrni o‘rganadilar.

grammar.en: Practise concessions with although/whereas/nevertheless, relative clauses and qualified claims with may or might. Plan timed responses around task value; preserve enough time to revise facts, structure and language.
grammar.uz: Although/whereas/nevertheless bilan yon berish, aniqlovchi ergash gaplar hamda may yoki might orqali ehtiyotkor xulosalarni mashq qiling. Dalillarni izchil bog‘lang. Misol, istisno va qarshi fikrni bir-biriga mantiqan bog‘lang.

task.en: Complete a short timed writing-and-listening cycle and explain your time allocation.
task.uz: Vaqt bilan qisqa mashq bajaring, keyin vaqtni qanday taqsimlaganingizni izohlang.

model.en: I outlined my main argument before starting the timed essay.
model.uz: Vaqtli inshoni boshlashdan oldin asosiy dalilimning rejasini tuzdim.

pitfall.en: Do not equate speed with skill when an answer remains incomplete or unsupported.
pitfall.uz: Tez bajarilgan, ammo to‘liq bo‘lmagan javobni muvaffaqiyat deb hisoblamang.

content.headingUz: CEFR B2 mavzu lug‘ati: 22 ta ibora

content.en: In a twelve-minute B2 practice block, students examine two short opinions about a bicycle-sharing programme. They identify the central claim, select one supporting example from each text, and write a balanced comparison. The final minute is reserved for checking whether their conclusion goes beyond the supplied evidence.
content.uz: O‘n ikki daqiqalik B2 mashqda talabalar velosiped ijarasi dasturi haqida ikki qisqa fikrni o‘rganadilar. Ular asosiy da’voni aniqlab, har bir matndan bittadan misol oladi va muvozanatli taqqoslash yozadi. Oxirgi daqiqada xulosa berilgan dalildan oshib ketmaganini tekshiradi.

content.en: In her feedback journal, Dilnoza notices that she uses however after every sentence, even when the ideas do not contrast. She also describes a small survey result as proving that everyone agrees. The revision task asks her to choose connectors by meaning and replace absolute claims with more cautious language.
content.uz: Dilnoza mulohaza daftarida fikrlar qarama-qarshi bo‘lmaganda ham har gapdan keyin however yozishini sezadi. U kichik so‘rov natijasini hamma rozi ekanini isbotlaydi deb ham ta’riflaydi. Tahrir vazifasida bog‘lovchilarni ma’nosiga qarab tanlash va mutlaq da’volarni ehtiyotkor iboralar bilan almashtirish so‘raladi.

content.en: A research brief examines proposals to limit water use during unusually dry summers. One group favours strict household quotas, whereas farmers request incentives for modern irrigation equipment. The report cautions that its sample excludes seasonal workers, so the apparent consensus should not be treated as universal support.
content.uz: Tadqiqot xulosasida quruq yoz oylarida suv ishlatishni cheklash takliflari ko‘rib chiqiladi. Bir guruh uy xo‘jaliklari uchun qat’iy me’yorni yoqlaydi, dehqonlar esa zamonaviy sug‘orish uskunasiga rag‘bat so‘raydi. Hisobotda tanlama mavsumiy ishchilarni qamramagani sabab ko‘ringan yakdillik umumiy qo‘llab-quvvatlash deb olinmasligi aytiladi.

content.en: At an expert roundtable, engineers discuss energy storage for a rapidly growing city. One expert argues that batteries can support evening demand; another warns that replacement costs and supply chains are often excluded from optimistic projections. The moderator asks each speaker to qualify predictions rather than speak in absolute terms.
content.uz: Mutaxassislar davra suhbatida o‘sib borayotgan shahar uchun energiya saqlash masalasini muhokama qiladi. Bir mutaxassis batareyalar kechki talabni qoplashi mumkinligini aytadi, boshqasi almashtirish xarajati va ta’minot zanjiri ko‘pincha juda ijobiy prognozga kiritilmasligini ogohlantiradi. Moderator mutlaq gaplar o‘rniga shartli bashorat qilishni so‘raydi.

examples.en: The speaker appeared to endorse the proposal while quietly questioning its assumptions.
examples.uz: So‘zlovchi taklifni ma’qullayotgandek ko‘rindi, ammo uning taxminlarini sekin shubha ostiga oldi.

examples.en: Her understated remark conveyed more criticism than a direct objection might have done.
examples.uz: Uning yumshoq izohi bevosita e’tirozdan ham kuchliroq tanqidni bildirdi.

examples.en: We inferred the change in attitude from the speaker's pacing and emphasis.
examples.uz: Munosabatdagi o‘zgarishni so‘zlovchining sur’ati va urg‘usidan aniqladik.

examples.en: A qualified endorsement should not be mistaken for unconditional support.
examples.uz: Shartli ma’qullashni so‘zsiz qo‘llab-quvvatlash bilan adashtirmaslik kerak.

examples.en: The conversation's subtext suggested concern about institutional reputation.
examples.uz: Suhbatning tagma’nosi muassasa obro‘siga doir xavotirni ko‘rsatdi.

examples.en: His deliberate ambiguity allowed several interpretations of the proposed decision.
examples.uz: Uning ataylab noaniq gapirishi taklif qilingan qarorning bir necha talqiniga imkon berdi.

examples.en: The seemingly neutral statement concealed an assumption about public behaviour.
examples.uz: Betarafdek ko‘ringan gap jamoatchilik xatti-harakati haqidagi taxminni yashirdi.

examples.en: A slight change of intonation distinguished reassurance from scepticism.
examples.uz: Intonatsiyadagi kichik o‘zgarish taskinni shubhadan ajratdi.

examples.en: The second speaker reconstructed the argument rather than merely repeating the claim.
examples.uz: Ikkinchi so‘zlovchi da’voni takrorlamasdan dalilni qayta tikladi.

examples.en: We considered whether the criticism was aimed at the evidence or the method.
examples.uz: Tanqid dalilga yoki usulga qaratilganini ko‘rib chiqdik.

examples.en: The final concession altered the meaning of the entire exchange.
examples.uz: Yakuniy yon berish butun suhbat ma’nosini o‘zgartirdi.

examples.en: Understanding nuanced listening requires attention to what remains unsaid.
examples.uz: Nozik ma’noli tinglashni tushunish aytilmay qolgan jihatlarga e’tibor talab qiladi.

content.en: An analytical essay asks whether artificial intelligence should support teachers in providing feedback. Advocates describe rapid personalised suggestions, while sceptics question reliability and the loss of human judgement. A close reader must separate what the author actually demonstrates from broader claims about the future of education.
content.uz: Tahliliy maqolada sun’iy intellekt o‘qituvchilarga mulohaza berishda yordam berishi kerakmi degan savol qo‘yiladi. Tarafdorlar tezkor shaxsiy tavsiyalarni ta’riflaydi, shubhalanuvchilar esa ishonchlilik va insoniy baholashning kamayishini so‘raydi. Diqqatli o‘quvchi muallif dalil bilan ko‘rsatgan narsani ta’lim kelajagi haqidagi keng da’volardan ajratadi.

examples.en: The two articles rely on different assumptions about the same social phenomenon.
examples.uz: Ikkala maqola bir xil ijtimoiy hodisa haqida turli taxminlarga tayanadi.

examples.uz: Ishonarli izoh har doim ham yetarli dalil bilan asoslanmaydi.

examples.uz: Muallif masalani yoritishda iqtisodiy omillarga madaniy omillardan ko‘proq ahamiyat beradi.

examples.en: We compared the methodological limitations before drawing a joint conclusion.
examples.uz: Umumiy xulosa chiqarishdan oldin uslubiy cheklovlarni solishtirdik.

examples.en: One source acknowledges uncertainty, whereas the other presents a categorical claim.
examples.uz: Bir manba noaniqlikni tan oladi, boshqasi esa qat’iy da’vo bildiradi.

examples.en: The evidence supports a cautious interpretation but not a universal rule.
examples.uz: Dalillar ehtiyotkor talqinni qo‘llaydi, ammo umumiy qoidani emas.

examples.en: An interpretative framework can reveal bias in the selection of examples.
examples.uz: Talqin asoslari misollar tanlanishidagi tarafkashlikni ko‘rsatishi mumkin.

examples.en: The conclusion integrates competing perspectives without erasing their differences.
examples.uz: Xulosa raqobatlashuvchi qarashlarni farqlarini yo‘qotmasdan birlashtiradi.

examples.en: A counterfactual question helps test whether the proposed cause is decisive.
examples.uz: Muqobil ehtimoliy savol taklif qilingan sabab hal qiluvchi ekanini tekshirishga yordam beradi.

examples.en: Readers should examine whether quotations represent the wider context fairly.
examples.uz: O‘quvchilar iqtiboslar kengroq kontekstni adolatli aks ettirishini tekshirishlari kerak.

examples.uz: Asl tadqiqot usullari solishtirilganda ko‘rinadigan ziddiyat aniqroq bo‘ladi.

content.en: A student compares two reports on online assessment. The first finds improved access for remote learners; the second raises concerns about identity checks and unequal internet speeds. A responsible synthesis does not average the conclusions mechanically. It explains where the evidence is compatible and where the studies ask different questions.
content.uz: Talaba onlayn baholash haqidagi ikkita hisobotni taqqoslaydi. Birinchisi olisdagi o‘quvchilarga kirish imkoniyati kengayganini ko‘rsatadi, ikkinchisi shaxsni tekshirish va internet tezligidagi tengsizlikdan xavotir bildiradi. Mas’uliyatli umumlashtirish xulosalarni shunchaki o‘rtachalamaydi. U dalillar qayerda mos kelishini va tadqiqotlar qayerda boshqa savol berishini tushuntiradi.

examples.en: The report synthesises several sources while identifying the limits of each.
examples.uz: Hisobot bir nechta manbani umumlashtirib, har birining cheklovlarini ko‘rsatadi.

examples.en: A formal recommendation should follow from the evidence rather than personal preference.
examples.uz: Rasmiy tavsiya shaxsiy diddan emas, dalillardan kelib chiqishi kerak.

examples.en: We attributed the estimate to its original source to avoid misleading readers.
examples.uz: O‘quvchilarni chalg‘itmaslik uchun hisob-kitobni asl manbasiga bog‘ladik.

examples.en: The introductory paragraph establishes the scope and purpose of the analysis.
examples.uz: Kirish xatboshisi tahlil qamrovi va maqsadini belgilaydi.

examples.en: A measured qualification prevents the findings from sounding more certain than they are.
examples.uz: Ehtiyotkor aniqlashtirish natijalarni haddan tashqari qat’iy ko‘rsatishdan saqlaydi.

examples.en: The middle section reconciles apparently contradictory findings through careful comparison.
examples.uz: O‘rta bo‘lim ehtiyotkor taqqoslash orqali zid ko‘ringan natijalarni muvofiqlashtiradi.

examples.en: The writer maintained a professional tone even when criticising the policy.
examples.uz: Muallif siyosatni tanqid qilganda ham professional ohangni saqladi.

examples.en: Each recommendation is linked to a clearly stated institutional constraint.
examples.uz: Har bir tavsiya aniq bayon qilingan muassasa chekloviga bog‘langan.

examples.en: The conclusion highlights unresolved risks instead of concealing them.
examples.uz: Xulosa hal bo‘lmagan xavflarni yashirmasdan ta’kidlaydi.

examples.en: Our revision improved the hierarchy of evidence across the report.
examples.uz: Tahrir hisobot davomida dalillar tartibini yaxshiladi.

content.en: Three colleagues debate whether a new language assessment should prioritise fluency or grammatical accuracy. A facilitator reframes the argument by asking which decisions the scores will support. She acknowledges that both dimensions matter, then proposes a rubric with separate criteria instead of claiming that one measure is sufficient.
content.uz: Uch hamkasb yangi til baholashda ravonlikmi yoki grammatik aniqlikmi muhimroq ekanini bahslashadi. Vositachi ballar qaysi qaror uchun kerakligini so‘rab, bahsni qayta yo‘naltiradi. U ikkala jihat ham muhimligini tan olib, bitta o‘lchov yetarli demasdan alohida mezonli jadvalni taklif qiladi.

examples.en: I recognise the merit of your proposal, but its implementation raises several concerns.
examples.uz: Taklifingizning foydasini tan olaman, ammo uni amalga oshirish bir qancha xavotir uyg‘otadi.

examples.en: Rather than rejecting the idea outright, I would suggest a phased approach.
examples.uz: Fikrni butunlay rad etish o‘rniga bosqichma-bosqich yondashuvni taklif qilardim.

examples.en: The apparent disagreement stems from different interpretations of the same evidence.
examples.uz: Ko‘rinadigan kelishmovchilik bir xil dalilning turlicha talqinidan kelib chiqadi.

examples.en: Let me distinguish the short-term effect from the broader structural consequences.
examples.uz: Keling, qisqa muddatli ta’sirni kengroq tizimli oqibatlardan ajratay.

examples.en: Your observation is persuasive, although it leaves an important assumption unexamined.
examples.uz: Kuzatuvingiz ishontiruvchi, ammo muhim bir taxminni tekshirmay qoldiradi.

examples.en: A more cautious conclusion would reflect the limitations of the available data.
examples.uz: Ehtiyotkorroq xulosa mavjud ma’lumot cheklovlarini hisobga olardi.

examples.en: I would reframe the question in terms of access rather than convenience.
examples.uz: Savolni qulaylik emas, imkoniyat masalasi sifatida qayta ifodalagan bo‘lardim.

examples.en: We might reasonably ask who benefits most from the proposed reform.
examples.uz: Taklif qilingan islohotdan kim eng ko‘p foyda ko‘rishini so‘rash o‘rinli.

examples.en: The distinction matters because the two outcomes require different policies.
examples.uz: Bu farq muhim, chunki ikki natija turli siyosatni talab qiladi.

examples.en: Allow me to address the counterargument before drawing a final conclusion.
examples.uz: Yakuniy xulosa chiqarishdan oldin qarshi dalilga javob berishga ruxsat eting.

examples.en: I agree with the principle while remaining sceptical about the timetable.
examples.uz: Tamoyilga qo‘shilaman, ammo jadvalga nisbatan shubham bor.

examples.en: Overall, the discussion reveals a need for evidence-led compromise.
examples.uz: Umuman olganda, muhokama dalilga asoslangan murosa zarurligini ko‘rsatadi.

lesson.titleEn: Timed skill check · Uzbekistan Multilevel C1
objectivesEn: Understand the C1 communication task using a scenario specific to this lesson.
Learn 22 distinct expressions with Uzbek translations.
Study 12 bilingual example sentences and practise speaking the first eight aloud.
Apply the grammar focus, complete a guided language challenge and review a worked response.
Complete eight short checks, twelve guided speaking tasks and the 22-question lesson exam.
objectivesUz: Ushbu darsdagi C1 darajasiga mos muloqot vazifasini tushuning.
