content.en: Your task in “Timed skill check” is to recognise when “attempt” is useful. Identify the purpose of the national multilevel practice task and support each response with details from the passage. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Vaqtli ko‘nikma mashqi” darsida “urinish” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Milliy Multilevel mashqi maqsadini aniqlang va har bir javobni matndagi tafsilotlar bilan asoslang. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.
content.modelEn: A fifteen-minute C1 evidence-evaluation drill presents an editorial, a small survey and one expert quotation on urban green spaces.
content.modelUz: O‘n besh daqiqalik C1 dalil baholash mashqida shahar yashil hududlari haqida tahririy maqola, kichik so‘rov va mutaxassis iqtibosi beriladi.

grammar.en: Develop nuanced academic register with measured hedging, complex clause relations and careful source attribution. Plan timed responses around task value; preserve enough time to revise facts, structure and language.
grammar.uz: Ehtiyotkor cheklovchi iboralar, murakkab ergash gaplar va manbalarga aniq havola orqali nozik akademik uslubni rivojlantiring. Mulohazalarni nozik jihatlari bilan bayon qiling. Xulosa qanchalik ishonchli ekanini ifodalovchi nozik uslubiy vositalardan foydalaning.

task.en: Complete a short timed writing-and-listening cycle and explain your time allocation.
task.uz: Vaqt bilan qisqa mashq bajaring, keyin vaqtni qanday taqsimlaganingizni izohlang.

model.en: I allocated time according to the complexity rather than the order of questions.

Students identify assumptions, note what remains uncertain and produce a cautiously worded recommendation. This compact practice is not described as an official-length Multilevel mock examination.
content.uz: O‘n besh daqiqalik C1 dalil baholash mashqida shahar yashil hududlari haqida tahririy maqola, kichik so‘rov va mutaxassis iqtibosi beriladi. Talabalar taxminlarni topib, nimalar noaniq qolganini yozadi va ehtiyotkor tavsiya beradi. Ushbu qisqa mashq to‘liq rasmiy Multilevel sinovi sifatida ko‘rsatilmaydi.

content.en: An advanced learner reviews an essay and discovers that several statements sound more certain than the sources allow. She changes proves into suggests, specifies whose findings are being discussed, and removes an informal phrase from the conclusion. Her revised paragraph preserves the argument while improving attribution and academic register.
content.uz: Ilg‘or o‘quvchi inshosini ko‘rib, ayrim gaplar manbalardan ko‘ra qat’iyroq chiqayotganini sezadi. U proves so‘zini suggests bilan almashtiradi, qaysi muallif natijasi tilga olinganini aniq yozadi va xulosadagi norasmiy iborani olib tashlaydi. Tahrirlangan xatboshi dalilni saqlab, manbaga ishora va akademik uslubni yaxshilaydi.

A: Good morning. May I speak to Ms Rahimova?
B: I am afraid she is in a meeting. May I take a message?
A: Yes, please ask her to call me this afternoon.
B: Of course. Could I have your name and number?
A: My name is Farhod, and my number is on the email I sent.
B: Thank you. I will pass on your message.
content.uz:
A: Xayrli tong. Rahimova xonim bilan gaplashsam bo‘ladimi?
B: Afsuski, u yig‘ilishda. Xabar qoldirmoqchimisiz?
A: Ha, iltimos, tushdan keyin menga qo‘ng‘iroq qilishini ayting.
B: Albatta. Ismingiz va raqamingizni olsam bo‘ladimi?
A: Ismim Farhod, raqamim yuborgan xatimda bor.

content.modelUz: A: Nega kundalik mashq foydali deb o‘ylaysiz?

content.en:
A: Why do you think daily practice is useful?
B: Because short, regular sessions are easier to maintain.
A: Could you give me an example?
B: Ten minutes of revision each morning helps me remember words.
A: So your main point is consistency?
B: Exactly. A realistic routine matters more than a perfect plan.
content.uz:
A: Nega kundalik mashq foydali deb o‘ylaysiz?
B: Chunki qisqa, muntazam mashg‘ulotni davom ettirish osonroq.
A: Misol keltira olasizmi?
B: Har ertalab o‘n daqiqa takrorlash so‘zlarni eslab qolishimga yordam beradi.
A: Demak, asosiy fikringiz muntazamlikmi?
B: Aynan shunday. Haqiqiy reja mukammal rejadan muhimroq.

content.uz: “Muhokamalar” darsida “nuqtayi nazar” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Tabiiy suhbatni mashq qiling, mos qo‘shimcha javob bering va so‘zlaringiz vaziyatga mosligini tekshiring. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.

content.en:
A: Should schools allow students to use phones in class?
B: I think phones can help with research if teachers set clear rules.
A: I see your point, but they can also distract students.
B: That is true. Perhaps they should be used only for learning tasks.
A: We agree that the purpose matters.
B: Yes, the rules should support learning.
content.uz:
A: Maktablarda dars payti telefon ishlatishga ruxsat berish kerakmi?
B: O‘qituvchi aniq qoidalar qo‘ysa, telefon tadqiqotga yordam beradi deb o‘ylayman.
A: Fikringizni tushundim, ammo u chalg‘itishi ham mumkin.
B: To‘g‘ri. Balki faqat o‘quv topshiriqlarida ishlatish kerakdir.
A: Maqsad muhimligi haqida fikrimiz bir.
B: Ha, qoidalar o‘rganishga xizmat qilishi kerak.

content.en: Your task in “Introductions” is to recognise when “polite” is useful. Practise a natural exchange, give a relevant follow-up answer, and check whether your choice of words fits the situation. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Tanishuv” darsida “xushmuomala” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Tabiiy suhbatni mashq qiling, mos qo‘shimcha javob bering va so‘zlaringiz vaziyatga mosligini tekshiring. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.
content.modelEn: At a technology networking event in Tashkent, Nargiza introduces herself as a junior designer who builds accessible mobile interfaces.
content.modelUz: Toshkentdagi texnologiya uchrashuvida Nargiza o‘zini foydalanishga qulay mobil interfeyslar yaratuvchi yosh dizayner deb tanishtiradi.

content.en: At a technology networking event in Tashkent, Nargiza introduces herself as a junior designer who builds accessible mobile interfaces. She asks another attendee what problem his company is solving and explains why she wants to join a collaborative project. The conversation ends with a clear plan to exchange project links, not just polite greetings.
content.uz: Toshkentdagi texnologiya uchrashuvida Nargiza o‘zini foydalanishga qulay mobil interfeyslar yaratuvchi yosh dizayner deb tanishtiradi. U boshqa qatnashchidan kompaniyasi qanday muammoni hal qilayotganini so‘raydi va hamkorlik loyihasiga nima uchun qo‘shilmoqchi ekanini tushuntiradi. Suhbat oddiy salomlashuv bilan emas, loyihalar havolasini almashish rejasi bilan tugaydi.
content.listenText: At a technology networking event in Tashkent, Nargiza introduces herself as a junior designer who builds accessible mobile interfaces. She asks another attendee what problem his company is solving and explains why she wants to join a collaborative project. The conversation ends with a clear plan to exchange project links, not just polite greetings.

The receptionist can offer a temporary room for one night but needs approval before changing the rest of the reservation. The traveller calmly explains the confirmation email, asks for a practical alternative and repeats the agreed arrangement.

content.en: During a class reflection, Malika describes an internship in which two team members disagreed about deadlines. She initially avoided the discussion, which caused confusion. After a supervisor suggested shorter weekly meetings, the group improved. Malika explains both what happened and what she would do differently next time.

content.en: A school wants to use QR codes to record attendance at after-school clubs. Azamat explains the system in three steps: members scan a code, the organiser checks the list, and absent students receive a reminder. A parent asks what happens when a phone has no internet connection, so Azamat describes a paper backup.

content.en: Your task in “Interviews” is to recognise when “interviewer” is useful. Practise a natural exchange, give a relevant follow-up answer, and check whether your choice of words fits the situation. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Suhbatlar” darsida “suhbat oluvchi” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Tabiiy suhbatni mashq qiling, mos qo‘shimcha javob bering va so‘zlaringiz vaziyatga mosligini tekshiring. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.
content.modelEn: At a scholarship interview, Javohir is asked to explain his strongest academic project.

content.en: At a scholarship interview, Javohir is asked to explain his strongest academic project. Instead of claiming that he did everything, he describes his role in collecting data and how another student designed the presentation. The interviewer asks about a mistake, and Javohir explains what the team learned from an inaccurate chart.
content.uz: Grant suhbatida Javohirdan eng yaxshi o‘quv loyihasini tushuntirish so‘raladi. U hamma ishni o‘zim qildim demay, ma’lumot yig‘ishdagi rolini va boshqa talabaning taqdimotni tayyorlaganini aytadi. Suhbatdosh xato haqida so‘raganda, Javohir jamoa noto‘g‘ri diagrammadan qanday saboq olganini tushuntiradi.

content.modelEn: A flight from Tashkent is cancelled after severe weather affects connecting routes.
content.modelUz: Ob-havo sabab Toshkentdan uchadigan reys bekor qilinadi va ulanish yo‘nalishlari ham o‘zgaradi.

content.en: A flight from Tashkent is cancelled after severe weather affects connecting routes. The airline proposes a later departure, but a passenger has an important appointment the next morning. The passenger distinguishes what the airline can guarantee from what is still uncertain and negotiates a workable alternative without accusing the agent personally.
content.uz: Ob-havo sabab Toshkentdan uchadigan reys bekor qilinadi va ulanish yo‘nalishlari ham o‘zgaradi. Aviakompaniya keyinroq jo‘nashni taklif qiladi, lekin yo‘lovchining ertasi kuni muhim uchrashuvi bor. U kafolatlangan narsani noaniq imkoniyatdan ajratib, xodimni shaxsan ayblamasdan muqobil yo‘lni kelishadi.

content.en: A software client calls to add new features three days before launch. The developer explains that changing the scope would put security testing at risk. Rather than refusing without discussion, she identifies the most urgent requirement, proposes a phased release, and asks the client to confirm the revised priority in writing.
content.uz: Dastur buyurtmachisi ishga tushirishdan uch kun oldin yangi funksiyalar so‘rab qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi. Dasturchi ish ko‘lamining o‘zgarishi xavfsizlik sinoviga xavf tug‘dirishini tushuntiradi. content.en: A project leader recalls a period when a limited budget forced her team to choose between better accessibility and additional visual effects. She initially favoured the more impressive design, but user testing revealed that visitors had difficulty reading key information. She now explains the ethical lesson without pretending that the decision was obvious at the time.
content.uz: Loyiha rahbari byudjet cheklangan paytda jamoasi foydalanishga qulaylik va qo‘shimcha vizual effektlardan birini tanlashi kerak bo‘lganini eslaydi. content.en: Your task in “Explaining ideas” is to recognise when “because” is useful. Practise a natural exchange, give a relevant follow-up answer, and check whether your choice of words fits the situation. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Fikrlarni tushuntirish” darsida “chunki” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Tabiiy suhbatni mashq qiling, mos qo‘shimcha javob bering va so‘zlaringiz vaziyatga mosligini tekshiring. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.
content.modelEn: An education director explains how an automated essay-feedback system works.
content.modelUz: Ta’lim direktori avtomatik insho tekshirish tizimini tushuntiradi.

content.en: An education director explains how an automated essay-feedback system works. The software identifies recurring language patterns, but a teacher still reviews unusual answers and checks whether suggestions suit the student's purpose. When a colleague asks about fairness, the director distinguishes useful assistance from decisions that should remain accountable to humans.
content.uz: Ta’lim direktori avtomatik insho tekshirish tizimini tushuntiradi. Dastur takrorlanuvchi til xatolarini topadi, biroq noodatiy javoblarni o‘qituvchi ko‘rib, maslahat o‘quvchi maqsadiga mosligini tekshiradi. Hamkasb adolat haqida so‘raganda direktor foydali yordam bilan odam javobgar bo‘lishi kerak bo‘lgan qarorlarni ajratadi.

content.en: In a public consultation on water pricing, farmers argue that higher charges could threaten small businesses, while planners say current prices encourage waste. A moderator invites both groups to define what affordability means in practice. She summarises their shared concerns before exploring a tariff that protects essential use and discourages excess consumption.
content.uz: Suv narxlari bo‘yicha jamoat muhokamasida dehqonlar yuqori to‘lov kichik xo‘jaliklarga zarar yetkazishi mumkinligini, rejalashtiruvchilar esa hozirgi narx isrofgarchilikka sabab bo‘lishini aytadi. Moderator har ikki tomondan arzonlik amalda nimani anglatishini aniqlashtirishni so‘raydi. U umumiy tashvishlarni jamlab, asosiy ehtiyojni himoya qiluvchi va ortiqcha sarfni kamaytiruvchi tarifni muhokama qiladi.

content.en: Your task in “Interviews” is to recognise when “candidate” is useful. Practise a natural exchange, give a relevant follow-up answer, and check whether your choice of words fits the situation. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Suhbatlar” darsida “nomzod” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Tabiiy suhbatni mashq qiling, mos qo‘shimcha javob bering va so‘zlaringiz vaziyatga mosligini tekshiring. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.
content.modelEn: In a senior management interview, Dilbar is asked about a time she challenged a popular decision.
content.modelUz: Yuqori rahbarlik suhbatida Dilbardan ko‘pchilik yoqlagan qarorga qarshi chiqqan vaqtini aytish so‘raladi.

content.en: In a senior management interview, Dilbar is asked about a time she challenged a popular decision. She describes a recruitment process that relied too heavily on personal recommendations and explains how she introduced clearer assessment criteria. When the panel questions the cost, she acknowledges the extra work while defending the need for fairness.
content.uz: Yuqori rahbarlik suhbatida Dilbardan ko‘pchilik yoqlagan qarorga qarshi chiqqan vaqtini aytish so‘raladi. U ishga olish jarayonida shaxsiy tavsiyalarga ortiqcha tayanilganini va aniqroq baholash mezonlarini joriy etganini tushuntiradi. Komissiya xarajatni so‘raganda u qo‘shimcha mehnatni tan olib, adolat zarurligini himoya qiladi.

content.en: An urban planner presents evidence on planting shade trees along major pedestrian routes. She compares projected cooling benefits with maintenance costs and admits that the available temperature measurements cover only one summer. During questions, she explains which further observations would strengthen the recommendation before public funds are committed.
content.uz: Shahar rejalashtiruvchisi piyodalar ko‘p yuradigan yo‘llarga soya beruvchi daraxtlar ekish dalillarini taqdim etadi. U sovitish foydasi prognozini xizmat xarajati bilan solishtirib, harorat ma’lumotlari faqat bitta yozni qamraganini tan oladi. Savollarda davlat mablag‘i ajratishdan oldin qaysi qo‘shimcha kuzatuvlar taklifni kuchaytirishini tushuntiradi.

content.en: Two officials disagree about making local transport data public. One argues that openness would help commuters plan journeys, while the other warns that detailed movement records could expose individuals. A facilitator separates aggregated statistics from personal data and asks whether the proposed release can meet both transparency and privacy goals.
content.uz: Ikki amaldor mahalliy transport ma’lumotini ochiq qilish haqida kelisha olmaydi. Biri oshkoralik yo‘lovchilarga safarni rejalashda yordam berishini aytadi, boshqasi esa batafsil harakat qaydlari odamlarning shaxsini ochishi mumkinligini ogohlantiradi. Vositachi umumiy statistikani shaxsiy ma’lumotdan ajratib, taklif oshkoralik va maxfiylikni birga ta’minlay oladimi deb so‘raydi.

content.en: At a municipal budget hearing, a librarian argues that evening opening hours would benefit working families and part-time students. A councillor prefers spending the money on new computers. Instead of dismissing the alternative, the librarian proposes a limited pilot, explains how success would be measured, and invites a review before the next budget cycle.
content.uz: Shahar byudjeti muhokamasida kutubxonachi kechki ish vaqti ishlovchi oilalar va sirtqi talabalarga yordam berishini aytadi. Kengash a’zosi mablag‘ni yangi kompyuterlarga sarflashni afzal ko‘radi. Kutubxonachi boshqa taklifni rad etmay, cheklangan sinov taklif qiladi, muvaffaqiyat qanday o‘lchanishini tushuntiradi va keyingi byudjetgacha natijani ko‘rib chiqishga chaqiradi.

Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Kafeda” darsida “taomnoma” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Suhbatdagi bir rolni bajaring, mos qo‘shimcha savol bering va suhbatni aniq keyingi qadamga olib boring. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.
content.modelEn: A: Good afternoon. Could I see the menu, please?
content.modelUz: A: Xayrli kun. Taomnoma bersangiz, iltimos.

content.en:
A: Good afternoon. Could I see the menu, please?
B: Certainly. Would you like something to drink?
A: A cup of tea and a bottle of water, please.
B: Would you like to order food as well?
A: Yes, vegetable soup. Is it available?
B: It is. Anything else?
A: That is all, thank you. May I have the bill later?
content.uz:
A: Xayrli kun. Taomnoma bersangiz, iltimos.
B: Albatta. Biror ichimlik olasizmi?
A: Bir piyola choy va bir shisha suv, iltimos.
B: Taom ham buyurtma qilasizmi?
A: Ha, sabzavotli sho‘rva. Bormi?
B: Bor. Yana nima kerak?
A: Shu xolos, rahmat. Keyin hisobni olsam bo‘ladimi?

content.en:
A: Excuse me, where is the check-in desk for flight 214?
B: It is in Terminal One, near entrance C.
A: Can I leave my luggage there?
B: Yes. Have your passport and ticket ready.
A: Do you know which gate we will use?
B: Gate information will appear on the screen.
A: Thank you. I will check the display.
content.uz:
A: Kechirasiz, 214-reysning ro‘yxatga olish joyi qayerda?
B: Birinchi terminalda, C kirish yonida.
A: Yukimni o‘sha yerda topshirsam bo‘ladimi?
B: Ha. Pasport va chiptangizni tayyorlang.
A: Qaysi chiqish eshigi ekanini bilasizmi?
B: Ma’lumot ekranda chiqadi.
A: Rahmat. Ekranni tekshiraman.

content.en:
A: Hello. I have a reservation under the name Ismoilova.
B: Welcome. Could I see your passport, please?
A: Certainly. Is breakfast included?
B: Yes, breakfast is served from seven to ten.
A: Great. What time do I need to check out?
B: Before eleven tomorrow morning. Here is your room key.
A: Thank you for your help.
content.uz:
A: Salom. Ismoilova nomiga xona band qilganman.
B: Xush kelibsiz. Pasportingizni ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi?
A: Albatta. Nonushta kiradimi?
B: Ha, nonushta yettidan o‘ngacha beriladi.
A: Juda yaxshi. Qachon chiqishim kerak?
B: Ertaga soat o‘n birdan oldin. Mana xona kalitingiz.
A: Yordamingiz uchun rahmat.

Bekzod goes to a small shop in Samarkand. A notebook costs twelve thousand so‘m and a pen costs five thousand so‘m. He asks the price again to check that he heard it correctly. He pays for one notebook and two pens.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. content.modelEn: I would prefer the morning train because I want to arrive early.
content.modelUz: Ertaroq yetib borish uchun ertalabki poyezdni afzal ko‘raman.

content.en:
Dilnoza is planning a weekend trip from Tashkent to Bukhara. She compares morning and evening train times, checks whether seats are available and asks about changing a booking. She chooses a morning departure because she wants to visit the old city before lunch.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Dilnoza Toshkentdan Buxoroga sayohatni rejalashtiradi. Poyezd vaqtlarini, joylarni va chipta o‘zgartirish shartlarini solishtiradi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

content.en:
Kamola calls a clinic to make an appointment. She has had a headache since yesterday, but she has no fever. The receptionist offers Tuesday at ten or Wednesday after lunch. Kamola chooses Tuesday and writes down the doctor's name.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Kamola bosh og‘rig‘i sabab klinikaga qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi. Unga ikki vaqt taklif etiladi, u seshanbani tanlaydi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

content.en: Your task in “Online purchase and refund” is to recognise when “The headphones arrived late and one side does not work. Could I have a refund?” is useful. content.headingEn: Case study: Online purchase and refund
content.en:
A student orders headphones online. The package arrives two days late, and the left side does not work. She reads the return policy, keeps the receipt and sends a polite message describing the problem. The store offers a replacement or a refund.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Talaba quloqchin buyurtma qiladi. Buyurtma kech keladi va bitta tomoni ishlamaydi. U chek bilan muloyim shikoyat yozadi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

content.en: Your task in “University application interview” is to recognise when “university application interview” is useful. Identify what the speaker needs, use the new language in context, and respond in complete sentences. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.

content.modelEn: I chose this subject because I enjoy solving practical problems.
content.modelUz: Amaliy muammolarni hal qilishni yoqtirganim uchun shu fanni tanladim.

content.en:
Jasur is applying for a university programme. An interviewer asks why he chose the subject, what project he enjoyed and how he managed a difficult deadline. Jasur gives one clear example and explains what he learned from teamwork.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Jasur universitet suhbatida fan tanlovi, loyihasi va muddat haqida gapiradi. U aniq misol va o‘rgangan sabog‘ini beradi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

content.en:
A neighbourhood group in Namangan wants safer crossings near a school. Residents propose new signs and better lighting, but the budget is limited. They hold a meeting to compare ideas, explain benefits and decide which request to send to the local council.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Namanganda mahalla aholisi maktab yaqinidagi yo‘lni xavfsiz qilish haqida bahslashadi. Byudjet cheklanganligi sabab ular takliflarni solishtiradi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

content.headingEn: Case study: Online privacy and evidence
content.en:
A class receives a suspicious message promising a scholarship. The sender requests a passport photo and a payment before providing details. The students check the university's official website, discuss warning signs and decide not to share private information.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Talabalar grant haqidagi shubhali xabarni tekshiradi. Unda pasport rasmi va to‘lov so‘raladi. Ular rasmiy veb-saytga qaraydi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

content.headingEn: Case study: Research findings and evidence
content.en:
Two groups survey students about online learning. One group asks fifty students from one class; the other includes several faculties. Their results differ. The research team discusses sample bias, cautious conclusions and how to distinguish correlation from causation in a short report.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Ikki guruh onlayn o‘qish haqida so‘rov o‘tkazadi, ammo tanlama hajmi va tarkibi turlicha. Ular xulosa chiqarishda ehtiyotkorlikni muhokama qiladi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.
content.listenText:

The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.

content.en:
A city committee considers putting solar panels on public buildings. Supporters expect lower long-term costs, while critics point to maintenance and initial investment. Members need to compare evidence, recognise uncertainty and make a balanced recommendation rather than a simple yes-or-no claim.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. A university committee is debating a new attendance policy. Some lecturers believe mandatory attendance improves participation; others argue that it penalises students with employment or caring responsibilities. A well-written policy brief must recognise the strength of both positions and state what further evidence would change the recommendation.

content.headingUz: Yangi iboralar: Ritorika va qarshi dalil

content.en:
An opinion column claims that artificial intelligence will inevitably replace most language teachers. A careful reader separates evidence from prediction, identifies emotive language and asks whether alternative models of teaching were considered. A persuasive response addresses the strongest version of the author's claim.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Maqolada sun’iy intellekt ko‘pchilik til o‘qituvchilarini almashtirishi aytiladi. O‘quvchi dalil, taxmin va hissiy ifodani ajratib, qarshi fikr yozadi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

content.headingEn: Understand the skill: Academic Task 1: comparison
content.en: Your task in “Academic Task 1: comparison” is to recognise when “academic task 1: comparison” is useful. Read the task conditions, practise the specific IELTS skill, and justify answers with the evidence in this unit. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Academic 1-vazifa: taqqoslash” darsida “academic 1-vazifa: taqqoslash” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Topshiriq shartini o‘qing, shu IELTS ko‘nikmasini mashq qiling va javoblarni matndagi dalil bilan asoslang. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.
content.modelEn: Overall, bus use increased, whereas the proportion travelling by car declined.
content.modelUz: Umuman olganda, avtobusdan foydalanish oshdi, avtomobilda qatnovchilar ulushi esa kamaydi.

grammar.en: Use higher than, lower than and twice as much as for comparisons; keep percentages and totals distinct.
grammar.uz: Taqqoslash uchun higher than, lower than va twice as much as ishlating; foiz bilan umumiy sonni farqlang.

task.en: Summarise an imaginary six-category pie chart in an overview and two comparisons without inventing exact data.
task.uz: Olti toifali tasavvuriy doiraviy diagrammani umumiy xulosa va ikkita taqqoslash bilan bayon qiling, aniq ma’lumotni o‘ylab topmang.

model.en: Food was the largest share, whereas entertainment was the smallest. Housing and transport together accounted for almost half of expenditure. The two smallest categories represented a minor proportion.
model.uz: Oziq-ovqat eng katta, ko‘ngilochar xarajatlar esa eng kichik ulush edi. Uy-joy va transport birgalikda xarajatlarning deyarli yarmini tashkil etdi. Ikki eng kichik toifaning ulushi oz edi.

pitfall.en: Do not supply made-up numbers as if a chart actually showed them.
pitfall.uz: Grafikda bo‘lmagan raqamlarni go‘yoki ko‘rsatilgandek yozmang.

content.en:
A practice chart compares the percentage of students using bicycles, buses and cars in two hypothetical years. You must identify the highest category, describe the main change and avoid inventing causes. Your summary needs an overview and selected comparisons rather than a list of every number.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.

Invented practice data (percent of all students): 2018: bicycle 12%, bus 33%, car 55%. 2025: bicycle 20%, bus 45%, car 35%. Figures total 100% each year. Your report must use these figures and no outside claims.
content.uz:
Mashq grafigida ikki yildagi transport tanlovi taqqoslanadi. Talaba umumiy yo‘nalish va asosiy farqlarni yozadi; sabablarni to‘qib chiqarmaydi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

O‘quv mashqi uchun taxminiy ma’lumotlar: 2018: velosiped 12%, avtobus 33%, mashina 55%. 2025: velosiped 20%, avtobus 45%, mashina 35%. Har yilda jami 100%.
content.listenText:
A practice chart compares the percentage of students using bicycles, buses and cars in two hypothetical years. You must identify the highest category, describe the main change and avoid inventing causes. Your summary needs an overview and selected comparisons rather than a list of every number.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.

Invented practice data (percent of all students): 2018: bicycle 12%, bus 33%, car 55%. 2025: bicycle 20%, bus 45%, car 35%. Figures total 100% each year. Your report must use these figures and no outside claims.

examples.en: The pie chart shows how household spending is divided among six categories.
examples.uz: Doiraviy diagramma oilaviy xarajatlar olti toifaga qanday bo‘linganini ko‘rsatadi.

examples.en: Food accounts for the largest share, whereas transport forms a smaller proportion.
examples.uz: Oziq-ovqat eng katta ulushni, transport esa kichikroq ulushni tashkil etadi.

examples.en: Two groups recorded almost equal percentages in the survey.
examples.uz: So‘rovdagi ikkita guruh deyarli teng foiz ko‘rsatgan.

examples.en: The difference between these categories was approximately eight percentage points.
examples.uz: Bu toifalar o‘rtasidagi farq taxminan sakkiz foiz punktini tashkil etdi.

examples.en: I grouped related values instead of describing every number separately.
examples.uz: Har bir sonni alohida bayon qilish o‘rniga yaqin qiymatlarni guruhladim.

examples.en: The overview highlights the most dominant and the least common choices.
examples.uz: Umumiy xulosa eng ko‘p va eng kam uchraydigan tanlovlarni ajratib ko‘rsatadi.

examples.en: The table reveals a substantial gap between urban and rural respondents.
examples.uz: Jadval shahar va qishloq qatnashchilari orasidagi sezilarli farqni ochib beradi.

examples.en: The smallest segment represents only a fraction of the overall total.
examples.uz: Eng kichik bo‘lak umumiy miqdorning juda oz qismini tashkil etadi.

examples.en: I used the chart labels to avoid mixing categories with measurements.
examples.uz: Toifalarni o‘lchov birliklari bilan chalkashtirmaslik uchun grafikdagi yorliqlardan foydalandim.

examples.en: A comparison sentence must identify what is being compared.
examples.uz: Taqqoslovchi gap nimaning nimaga qiyoslanayotganini aniq ko‘rsatishi kerak.

examples.en: The combined share of the two leading categories exceeds half of the total.
examples.uz: Yetakchi ikki toifaning birgalikdagi ulushi jami miqdorning yarmidan oshadi.

examples.en: I avoided claiming that the chart explained why people made these choices.
examples.uz: Diagramma odamlar nega bunday tanlov qilganini tushuntiradi deb da’vo qilmadim.

content.headingEn: Understand the skill: Academic Task 1: process
content.en: Your task in “Academic Task 1: process” is to recognise when “academic task 1: process” is useful. Read the task conditions, practise the specific IELTS skill, and justify answers with the evidence in this unit. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Academic 1-vazifa: jarayon” darsida “academic 1-vazifa: jarayon” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. content.en:
A hypothetical diagram shows rainwater collected from a roof, filtered, stored in a tank and distributed for garden irrigation. Write a neutral process description in logical stages. The reader should understand the order even without seeing the diagram, and the conclusion must not include personal recommendations.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Namunaviy chizmada yomg‘ir suvi yig‘ilib, filtrlanib, saqlanadi va sug‘orishga uzatiladi. Jarayon ketma-ket va betaraf tasvirlanadi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.
content.listenText:
A hypothetical diagram shows rainwater collected from a roof, filtered, stored in a tank and distributed for garden irrigation. Write a neutral process description in logical stages. The reader should understand the order even without seeing the diagram, and the conclusion must not include personal recommendations.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.

examples.en: The process begins when used plastic bottles are collected from households.
examples.uz: Jarayon ishlatilgan plastik idishlar xonadonlardan yig‘ilganda boshlanadi.

examples.en: First, workers separate recyclable materials from unsuitable waste.
examples.uz: Dastlab ishchilar qayta ishlanadigan materiallarni yaroqsiz chiqindidan ajratadilar.

examples.en: The bottles are then crushed into smaller pieces by a machine.
examples.uz: So‘ng idishlar maxsus uskuna yordamida mayda bo‘laklarga eziladi.

examples.en: After washing, the material passes through a controlled heating chamber.
examples.uz: Yuvilgach, material harorati nazorat qilinadigan isitish kamerasidan o‘tadi.

examples.en: The softened plastic is shaped into uniform pellets for further processing.
examples.uz: Yumshatilgan plastik keyingi qayta ishlash uchun bir xil granulalarga shakllantiriladi.

examples.en: Finally, the product is packaged before being sent to manufacturers.
examples.uz: Oxirida mahsulot ishlab chiqaruvchilarga yuborilishidan oldin qadoqlanadi.

examples.en: The diagram illustrates a linear process with seven main stages.
examples.uz: Sxema yetti asosiy bosqichli chiziqli jarayonni ko‘rsatadi.

examples.en: A cycle has no single final stage because the sequence repeats.
examples.uz: Takroriy jarayonning bitta yakuniy bosqichi bo‘lmaydi, chunki ketma-ketlik qaytariladi.

examples.en: The description should use present simple and passive forms where appropriate.
examples.uz: Tavsifda kerakli o‘rinlarda hozirgi oddiy zamon va majhul nisbat ishlatilishi kerak.

examples.en: I explained the order of operations without inventing extra machinery.
examples.uz: Qo‘shimcha uskunalarni o‘ylab topmasdan ishlar tartibini tushuntirdim.

examples.en: Arrows indicate how each intermediate product moves to the next stage.
examples.uz: Strelkalar har bir oraliq mahsulot keyingi bosqichga qanday o‘tishini bildiradi.

examples.en: Temperature is mentioned only where it is shown in the diagram.
examples.uz: Harorat faqat sxemada ko‘rsatilgan joyda tilga olinadi.

content.headingEn: Understand the skill: Academic seminar listening
content.en: Your task in “Academic seminar listening” is to recognise when “academic seminar listening” is useful. Read the task conditions, practise the specific IELTS skill, and justify answers with the evidence in this unit. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Akademik ma’ruzani tinglash” darsida “akademik ma’ruzani tinglash” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Topshiriq shartini o‘qing, shu IELTS ko‘nikmasini mashq qiling va javoblarni matndagi dalil bilan asoslang. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.

content.en:
In a short practice seminar, a lecturer distinguishes renewable resources from non-renewable ones. She first defines the concepts, then gives examples and finally challenges a common misconception about costs. Listen once without looking at the transcript, take keywords and listen again for signposting phrases.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Qisqa mashq ma’ruzasida o‘qituvchi qayta tiklanadigan va tiklanmaydigan resurslarni taqqoslaydi. Avval tinglab kalit so‘zlarni yozing.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.

content.headingEn: Case study: General Training: formal request letter
content.en:
You recently moved into a rented flat and the heating has stopped working. Write to the property manager describing when the problem began, how it affects you and what action you expect. Use a polite but firm tone and make the requested next step unambiguous.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Siz ijaradagi uyga ko‘chdingiz va isitish ishlamay qoldi. Menejerga muammo, uning ta’siri va kutilayotgan yechim haqida rasmiy xat yozing.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

content.headingEn: Understand the skill: General Training: workplace reading
content.headingUz: Ko‘nikmani tushuning: General Training: ishga oid matn
content.en: Your task in “General Training: workplace reading” is to recognise when “general training: workplace reading” is useful. Read the task conditions, practise the specific IELTS skill, and justify answers with the evidence in this unit. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “General Training: ishga oid matn” darsida “general training: ishga oid matn” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Topshiriq shartini o‘qing, shu IELTS ko‘nikmasini mashq qiling va javoblarni matndagi dalil bilan asoslang. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.

model.en: All new employees must complete the induction. Experienced staff may request additional training unless the programme is full. Temporary workers are exempt from the optional workshop.

content.headingEn: Case study: General Training: workplace reading
content.headingUz: Vaziyat: General Training: ishga oid matn
content.en:
A workplace notice explains that staff must book a training room at least two days in advance. Cancellations should be reported by email, and visitors need an identification badge. Read the notice to find exact conditions, distinguish rules from recommendations and identify who is responsible.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Ish joyi e’lonida xona bron qilish, bekor qilish va mehmon nishoni qoidalari berilgan. Aniq talablarni aniqlang.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

content.en: Your task in “General Training: complaint and response” is to recognise when “general training: complaint and response” is useful. Read the task conditions, practise the specific IELTS skill, and justify answers with the evidence in this unit. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “General Training: shikoyatga javob” darsida “general training: shikoyatga javob” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Topshiriq shartini o‘qing, shu IELTS ko‘nikmasini mashq qiling va javoblarni matndagi dalil bilan asoslang. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.

task.en: Write a complaint that identifies the purchase, reports the defect and requests a specific remedy.

model.en: I purchased a washing machine on Monday, but it stopped working two days later. I contacted support and followed the troubleshooting steps without success. I therefore request a replacement under the warranty.
model.uz: Dushanba kuni kir yuvish mashinasi sotib oldim, ammo ikki kundan so‘ng ishlamay qoldi. Yordam xizmatiga bog‘lanib, ko‘rsatmalarni bajardim, lekin natija bo‘lmadi. Shu sababli kafolat bo‘yicha almashtirishni so‘rayman.

pitfall.en: An angry tone without evidence weakens an otherwise justified complaint.
pitfall.uz: Dalilsiz g‘azabli ohang asosli shikoyatning ham kuchini kamaytiradi.

content.headingEn: Case study: General Training: complaint and response
content.en:
A customer reports that a package was damaged during delivery. The company apologises but first requests photographs and the order number before choosing a remedy. For reading practice, distinguish the complaint, evidence requested, proposed action and the time frame.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Mijoz shikastlangan posilka haqida shikoyat qiladi. Kompaniya buyurtma raqami va rasmlarni so‘raydi. Xatdagi maqsad va talablarni toping.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.

repeat.en: Please provide the order number and photographs so we can investigate the damage.
repeat.uz: Zararni tekshirishimiz uchun buyurtma raqami va rasmlarni yuboring.

repeat.en: I am writing to complain about a washing machine delivered last Thursday.

repeat.en: The appliance stopped working after only two days of normal use.
repeat.uz: Jihoz odatiy foydalanishning atigi ikki kunidan keyin ishlamay qoldi.

repeat.en: I have attached a copy of the receipt and photographs of the damage.
repeat.uz: Kvitansiya nusxasi va shikastlanish suratlarini ilova qildim.

repeat.en: I would prefer a replacement because the product is still under warranty.
repeat.uz: Mahsulot hali kafolatda bo‘lgani uchun almashtirishni afzal ko‘raman.

repeat.en: Please confirm how long the inspection and repair process will take.
repeat.uz: Tekshiruv va ta’mirlash qancha davom etishini tasdiqlab bering.

repeat.en: The reply should acknowledge the problem before offering a practical solution.
repeat.uz: Javob amaliy yechim taklif qilishdan oldin muammoni tan olishi kerak.

repeat.en: I remained polite while making the requested action very clear.
repeat.uz: So‘ralgan harakatni aniq ifodalab, muloyimlikni saqladim.

repeat.en: The company offered a partial refund instead of the requested replacement.
repeat.uz: Kompaniya so‘ralgan almashtirish o‘rniga qisman pul qaytarishni taklif qildi.

repeat.en: I asked for a written response within a reasonable timeframe.
repeat.uz: Oqilona vaqt ichida yozma javob so‘radim.

repeat.en: The follow-up message summarised our earlier telephone conversation.
repeat.uz: Keyingi xabar avvalgi telefon suhbatimizni qisqacha bayon qildi.

repeat.en: I checked whether the complaint described facts rather than exaggerated accusations.
repeat.uz: Shikoyatda bo‘rttirilgan ayblovlar emas, faktlar bayon qilinganini tekshirdim.

repeat.en: A clear resolution would help both the customer and the service provider.
repeat.uz: Aniq yechim mijozga ham, xizmat ko‘rsatuvchiga ham yordam beradi.

repeat.en: A customer reports that a package was damaged during delivery.

objectivesEn: Understand the B1 communication task using a scenario specific to this lesson.
Learn 27 distinct expressions with Uzbek translations.
Study 12 bilingual example sentences and practise speaking the first eight aloud.
Apply the grammar focus, complete a guided language challenge and review a worked response.

content.headingEn: Case study: National exam: practical email
content.en:
You are organising an English club meeting in Andijan. A guest speaker is late, so you must email participants about a new starting time and room. State the changes, give a reason and tell students whom to contact with questions.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Andijondagi ingliz tili klubi uchrashuvi vaqti va xonasi o‘zgardi. Ishtirokchilarga o‘zgarishni va sababini tushuntirib xat yozing.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

content.en: Your task in “National exam: familiar listening” is to recognise when “national exam: familiar listening” is useful. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.

content.headingEn: Case study: National exam: familiar listening
content.en:
An announcement at a community centre says that the library will close early on Friday because of electrical repairs. Visitors may return books on Saturday morning. Identify the day, reason and alternative arrangement before checking the transcript.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Mahalla markazi e’lonida kutubxona juma kuni erta yopilishi va kitoblarni shanbada qaytarish mumkinligi aytiladi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.

examples.uz: E’londagi ko‘cha nomini takrorlab bera olasizmi?

examples.en: The speaker mentioned a cancellation, not a short delay.
examples.uz: So‘zlovchi qisqa kechikishni emas, bekor qilinishni aytdi.

examples.en: We checked the updated timetable before leaving home.
examples.uz: Uydan chiqishdan oldin yangilangan jadvalni tekshirdik.

examples.en: The operator confirmed that the service starts at eight.
examples.uz: Operator xizmat soat sakkizda boshlanishini tasdiqladi.

examples.en: I missed the first number, so I listened to the recording again.
examples.uz: Birinchi raqamni tushunmaganim uchun yozuvni yana tingladim.

examples.en: Please call the emergency number only if someone needs urgent help.
examples.uz: Iltimos, favqulodda raqamga faqat tez yordam zarur bo‘lsa qo‘ng‘iroq qiling.

content.headingEn: Case study: National exam: opinion paragraph
content.en:
A class is asked whether students should join after-school clubs. Write a short opinion with two reasons and one example from school life. Keep the language clear, and make sure the final sentence follows from the reasons instead of introducing a new topic.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
O‘quvchilar maktabdan keyingi klublarga qatnashishi kerakmi? Ikki sabab va bir misolli sodda fikr paragrafi yozing.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.
content.listenText:
A class is asked whether students should join after-school clubs. Write a short opinion with two reasons and one example from school life. Keep the language clear, and make sure the final sentence follows from the reasons instead of introducing a new topic.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.

examples.uz: Uyda diqqatni jamlash uchun o‘quvchilarga tinch joy kerak.

examples.uz: Ushbu misol amaliy o‘qish haqidagi fikrimni asoslaydi.

content.headingEn: Case study: National exam: conflicting views
content.en:
Two articles disagree on whether remote work improves productivity. One cites reduced commuting, while the other stresses the loss of informal communication. Compare the main claims, separate supporting examples from conclusions and write a balanced response.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Ikki maqola masofaviy ishning unumdorlikka ta’siri haqida turlicha fikr bildiradi. Dalil va xulosalarni taqqoslang.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.
content.listenText:
Two articles disagree on whether remote work improves productivity. One cites reduced commuting, while the other stresses the loss of informal communication. Compare the main claims, separate supporting examples from conclusions and write a balanced response.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.

examples.en: Both proposals offer benefits, but they place different demands on local budgets.
examples.uz: Ikkala taklifning foydasi bor, ammo ular mahalliy byudjetga turlicha talab qo‘yadi.

examples.en: Supporters emphasise convenience, whereas critics focus on long-term cost.
examples.uz: Tarafdorlar qulaylikni ta’kidlaydi, tanqidchilar esa uzoq muddatli xarajatga e’tibor qaratadi.

examples.en: A fair comparison should consider people with different needs.
examples.uz: Adolatli taqqoslash turli ehtiyojdagi odamlarni hisobga olishi kerak.

examples.en: The policy may help city residents while creating difficulties for villages.
examples.uz: Siyosat shahar aholisiga yordam berib, qishloqlar uchun qiyinchilik tug‘dirishi mumkin.

examples.en: We should distinguish immediate savings from lasting social value.
examples.uz: Darhol tejaladigan mablag‘ni uzoq muddatli ijtimoiy foydadan ajratishimiz kerak.

examples.en: The alternative proposal reduces cost without removing essential services.
examples.uz: Muqobil taklif zarur xizmatlarni olib tashlamasdan xarajatni kamaytiradi.

examples.en: A reasonable objection deserves a direct answer, not dismissal.
examples.uz: Asosli e’tiroz rad etilish emas, bevosita javobga loyiq.

examples.en: I accept the environmental benefits, provided the system remains affordable.
examples.uz: Tizim hamyonbop qolsa, ekologik foydasini tan olaman.

examples.en: Our conclusion reflects the strengths and weaknesses of both approaches.
examples.uz: Xulosamiz ikkala yondashuvning kuchli va zaif tomonlarini aks ettiradi.

examples.en: The evidence is promising, although the sample is rather small.
examples.uz: Dalillar umidli, garchi namuna hajmi ancha kichik bo‘lsa ham.

examples.en: This disagreement concerns implementation rather than the overall objective.
examples.uz: Bu kelishmovchilik umumiy maqsadga emas, amalga oshirishga taalluqli.

examples.en: An informed choice requires clear information about practical constraints.
examples.uz: Ongli tanlov amaliy cheklovlar haqida aniq ma’lumot talab qiladi.

content.headingEn: Case study: National exam: argument essay
content.en:
Your local council is considering a rule to reduce disposable plastic at public events. Supporters cite cleaner streets; organisers worry about the cost of alternatives. Plan an essay that acknowledges both sides, evaluates costs and makes a justified recommendation.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Mahalliy tadbirlarda bir martalik plastikni kamaytirish taklifi bahsga sabab bo‘ldi. Qarashlarni solishtirib, asosli esse yozing.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.
content.listenText:
Your local council is considering a rule to reduce disposable plastic at public events. Supporters cite cleaner streets; organisers worry about the cost of alternatives. Plan an essay that acknowledges both sides, evaluates costs and makes a justified recommendation.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.

examples.en: My thesis argues that public spaces deserve greater investment.
examples.uz: Tezisim jamoat joylariga ko‘proq sarmoya kerakligini ta’kidlaydi.

examples.en: The first paragraph explains the health benefits of accessible parks.
examples.uz: Birinchi xatboshi hammaga ochiq bog‘larning sog‘liq uchun foydasini tushuntiradi.

examples.en: Critics worry about maintenance costs, which should be acknowledged.
examples.uz: Tanqidchilar saqlash xarajatidan xavotirda, buni tan olish kerak.

examples.en: Nevertheless, a well-planned project may reduce other public expenses.
examples.uz: Shunga qaramay, puxta rejalangan loyiha boshqa davlat xarajatlarini kamaytirishi mumkin.

examples.en: I used a local example instead of making an unsupported generalisation.
examples.uz: Asossiz umumlashtirish o‘rniga mahalliy misoldan foydalandim.

examples.en: Reliable sources strengthen an essay more than emotional language.
examples.uz: Ishonchli manbalar inshoni hissiy tildan ko‘ra kuchliroq qiladi.

examples.en: A cause-and-effect explanation should connect every stage logically.
examples.uz: Sabab-oqibat tushuntirishi har bir bosqichni mantiqan bog‘lashi kerak.

examples.en: The final paragraph recommends a gradual rather than immediate change.
examples.uz: Yakuniy xatboshi darhol emas, bosqichma-bosqich o‘zgarishni tavsiya qiladi.

examples.en: I partly accept the opposing argument because resources are limited.
examples.uz: Resurslar cheklanganligi sabab qarshi dalilga qisman qo‘shilaman.

examples.en: The essay remains consistent even when it recognises an alternative view.
examples.uz: Insho muqobil qarashni tan olsa ham izchil qoladi.

examples.en: A precise qualification prevents the argument from sounding absolute.
examples.uz: Aniq cheklov dalilning haddan tashqari qat’iy eshitilishiga yo‘l qo‘ymaydi.

examples.en: My recommendation follows from the examples in the two body paragraphs.
examples.uz: Tavsiyam ikki asosiy xatboshidagi misollardan kelib chiqadi.

content.headingEn: Focus skill: National exam: speaker intention
content.headingUz: Asosiy ko‘nikma: Milliy imtihon: so‘zlovchi maqsadi
content.en: Your task in “National exam: speaker intention” is to recognise when “The speaker acknowledges the inconvenience and proposes an alternative arrangement.” is useful. Identify the purpose of the national multilevel practice task and support each response with details from the passage. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Milliy imtihon: so‘zlovchi maqsadi” darsida “So‘zlovchi noqulaylikni tan oladi va muqobil reja taklif qiladi.” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Milliy Multilevel mashqi maqsadini aniqlang va har bir javobni matndagi tafsilotlar bilan asoslang. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.

content.headingEn: Case study: National exam: speaker intention
content.en:
In a practice talk, a university coordinator announces a change to the timetable. She mentions the inconvenience, explains that classrooms are being renovated and offers online sessions as an alternative. Decide which parts express information, reassurance and a request.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Universitet koordinatori jadval o‘zgarishini, sababini va muqobil onlayn mashg‘ulotni aytadi. Xabar, taskin va iltimosni ajrating.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.
content.listenText:
In a practice talk, a university coordinator announces a change to the timetable. She mentions the inconvenience, explains that classrooms are being renovated and offers online sessions as an alternative. Decide which parts express information, reassurance and a request.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.

examples.en: When he said that was interesting, his tone suggested disagreement.
examples.uz: U bu qiziq ekan deganda, ohangi kelishmovchilikni anglatdi.

examples.en: The speaker avoided a direct refusal by suggesting a later meeting.
examples.uz: So‘zlovchi keyinroq uchrashishni taklif qilib, bevosita rad javobidan qochdi.

examples.en: She sounded pleased, although her words included a subtle warning.
examples.uz: So‘zlarida nozik ogohlantirish bo‘lsa-da, u mamnun eshitildi.

examples.en: The remark was ironic because the plan had clearly failed.
examples.uz: Reja aniq muvaffaqiyatsiz bo‘lgani uchun izoh kinoyali edi.

examples.en: We inferred the manager's priority from what she repeatedly questioned.
examples.uz: Rahbar nimani qayta-qayta so‘raganidan uning ustuvorligini bildik.

examples.en: A cautious suggestion is different from an enthusiastic recommendation.
examples.uz: Ehtiyotkor taklif ishtiyoq bilan berilgan tavsiyadan farq qiladi.

examples.en: The speaker's hesitation showed that the figures were not convincing.
examples.uz: So‘zlovchining ikkilanishi raqamlar ishontirmaganini ko‘rsatdi.

examples.en: A polite question can sometimes function as an indirect request.
examples.uz: Muloyim savol ba’zan bilvosita iltimos vazifasini bajaradi.

examples.en: The intention became clearer when we considered the previous conversation.
examples.uz: Oldingi suhbatni hisobga olganda maqsad aniqroq bo‘ldi.

examples.en: His approval was conditional on receiving more accurate information.
examples.uz: Uning ma’qullashi aniqroq ma’lumot olish shartiga bog‘liq edi.

examples.en: We replayed the sentence to compare its meaning with the speaker's tone.
examples.uz: Gap ma’nosini so‘zlovchi ohangi bilan solishtirish uchun uni qayta tingladik.

examples.en: Recognising implied meaning requires attention to both context and emphasis.
examples.uz: Yashirin ma’noni tushunish vaziyat va urg‘uga e’tibor berishni talab qiladi.

content.headingEn: Case study: National exam: critical synthesis
content.en:
An academic article argues that multilingual education improves employment opportunities. A second commentary questions whether language skills alone explain the observed outcomes. Produce a synthesis that recognises the evidence, discusses confounding factors and avoids overstating causation.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Bir maqola ko‘p tillilik ish imkonini oshirishini aytadi, ikkinchisi esa boshqa omillarni ko‘rsatadi. Ehtiyotkor sintez yozing.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.
content.listenText:
An academic article argues that multilingual education improves employment opportunities. A second commentary questions whether language skills alone explain the observed outcomes. Produce a synthesis that recognises the evidence, discusses confounding factors and avoids overstating causation.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.

content.headingEn: Focus skill: National exam: nuanced discussion
content.headingUz: Asosiy ko‘nikma: Milliy imtihon: nozik munozara
content.en: Your task in “National exam: nuanced discussion” is to recognise when “national exam: nuanced discussion” is useful. Identify the purpose of the national multilevel practice task and support each response with details from the passage. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Milliy imtihon: nozik munozara” darsida “milliy imtihon: nozik munozara” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Milliy Multilevel mashqi maqsadini aniqlang va har bir javobni matndagi tafsilotlar bilan asoslang. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.
content.modelEn: Preservation and modernisation need not be mutually exclusive if safety standards are met.
content.modelUz: Xavfsizlik talablari bajarilsa, tarixiylikni saqlash va modernizatsiya bir-biriga zid bo‘lmasligi mumkin.

grammar.en: Develop nuanced academic register with measured hedging, complex clause relations and careful source attribution. Separate the speaker’s or writer’s central position from concessions, examples and qualifications.
grammar.uz: Ehtiyotkor cheklovchi iboralar, murakkab ergash gaplar va manbalarga aniq havola orqali nozik akademik uslubni rivojlantiring. Mulohazalarni nozik jihatlari bilan bayon qiling. Xulosa qanchalik ishonchli ekanini ifodalovchi nozik uslubiy vositalardan foydalaning.

task.en: Produce an independent two-minute response with evidence and an acknowledged alternative.
task.uz: Dalilli mustaqil nutq tuzing, muqobil fikrni ham tan olib ikki daqiqa gapiring.

model.en: An informed debate begins by recognising the legitimate concerns on both sides.
model.uz: Xabardor munozara ikki tomonning asosli xavotirlarini tan olishdan boshlanadi.

pitfall.en: Avoid claiming certainty when the text or audio expresses only a possibility.
pitfall.uz: Matn ehtimolni aytsa, javobingizni aniq fakt sifatida bermang.

content.headingEn: Case study: National exam: nuanced discussion
content.en:
In a speaking scenario, a city must decide whether to preserve an old market or replace it with modern facilities. The candidate should explain competing priorities, anticipate an objection and propose a compromise with concrete conditions.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Og‘zaki mashqda shahar eski bozorni saqlash yoki yangilash haqida qaror qiladi. Nomzod manfaatlar, e’tiroz va murosani tushuntiradi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

examples.en: An informed debate begins by recognising the legitimate concerns on both sides.
examples.uz: Xabardor munozara ikki tomonning asosli xavotirlarini tan olishdan boshlanadi.

examples.en: Public responsibility cannot be reduced to a single financial measure.
examples.uz: Jamoat mas’uliyatini bitta moliyaviy ko‘rsatkichga keltirib bo‘lmaydi.

examples.en: I accept the intended benefit but question whether the policy is equitable.
examples.uz: Ko‘zlangan foydani tan olaman, ammo siyosat adolatlimi, deb so‘rayman.

examples.en: The proposal raises an ethical dilemma between efficiency and inclusion.
examples.uz: Taklif samaradorlik bilan hammaga imkon berish o‘rtasida axloqiy dilemma tug‘diradi.

examples.en: A thoughtful objection addresses the argument rather than attacking its author.
examples.uz: O‘rinli e’tiroz muallifga emas, dalilning o‘ziga qaratiladi.

examples.en: We should distinguish conflicting interests from fundamentally incompatible values.
examples.uz: Zid manfaatlarni mutlaqo mos kelmaydigan qadriyatlardan ajratishimiz kerak.

examples.en: The discussion remained constructive because participants explained their assumptions.
examples.uz: Ishtirokchilar taxminlarini tushuntirgani sabab muhokama konstruktiv bo‘ldi.

examples.en: One perspective prioritises individual freedom; another emphasises shared obligations.
examples.uz: Bir qarash shaxsiy erkinlikni ustuvor qiladi, boshqasi umumiy majburiyatni ta’kidlaydi.

examples.en: A measured criticism can preserve respect while challenging an important claim.
examples.uz: Me’yorli tanqid muhim da’voga qarshi chiqib, hurmatni saqlashi mumkin.

examples.en: Our compromise addresses the most urgent concerns without claiming perfection.
examples.uz: Murosamiz mukammallikka da’vo qilmasdan eng dolzarb xavotirlarni hal qiladi.

examples.en: Evidence matters even when the subject involves deeply held values.
examples.uz: Mavzu mustahkam qadriyatlarga taalluqli bo‘lsa ham dalil muhim.

examples.en: Responsible dialogue makes space for disagreement without distorting opposing views.
examples.uz: Mas’uliyatli muloqot qarshi qarashlarni buzmasdan kelishmovchilikka o‘rin beradi.

content.headingEn: Case study: National exam: formal synthesis
content.en:
A committee receives conflicting reports on student access to digital resources. One report measures device ownership; the other assesses reliable connectivity. Write an objective summary explaining why the indicators should not be treated as interchangeable.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Komissiya o‘quvchilarning raqamli imkoniyatlari bo‘yicha ikki xil hisobotni oladi. Qurilmaga egalik va sifatli internet bir xil ko‘rsatkich emas.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.
content.listenText:

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.

examples.en: Each recommendation is accompanied by a clear explanation of its limitations.
examples.uz: Har bir tavsiya cheklovlarining aniq izohi bilan birga berilgan.
