examples.en: The briefing notes where additional verification would strengthen the findings.
examples.uz: Ma’lumotnomada qo‘shimcha tekshiruv natijalarni qayerda kuchaytirishi aytilgan.

examples.en: A transparent report identifies both the source and the confidence level.
examples.uz: Oshkora hisobot manba bilan birga ishonchlilik darajasini ham ko‘rsatadi.

examples.en: The comparison indicates that smaller institutions face different implementation costs.
examples.uz: Taqqoslash kichik muassasalar boshqa amalga oshirish xarajatlariga duch kelishini ko‘rsatadi.

examples.en: We recommended a staged approach rather than an immediate system-wide change.
examples.uz: Darhol butun tizimni o‘zgartirish o‘rniga bosqichli yondashuvni tavsiya etdik.

examples.en: Our conclusions remain cautious because the sample covers only two regions.
examples.uz: Namuna faqat ikki hududni qamragani uchun xulosalarimiz ehtiyotkor.

examples.en: The final section prioritises feasible actions supported by multiple sources.
examples.uz: Yakuniy bo‘lim bir nechta manba bilan asoslangan amalga oshsa bo‘ladigan ishlarni ustuvor qiladi.

examples.en: A professional synthesis should make complexity understandable without concealing uncertainty.
examples.uz: Professional umumlashtirish murakkablikni tushunarli qilib, noaniqlikni yashirmasligi kerak.

content.headingUz: Yangi iboralar: Narxni xushmuomalalik bilan so‘rash

content.en:
In a market in Fergana, a shopper asks how much fresh fruit costs and whether a smaller quantity is available. The seller answers and the shopper repeats the final price before paying. Practise short questions without speaking too quickly.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Farg‘onadagi bozorda xaridor meva narxi va miqdorini so‘raydi. To‘lashdan avval narxni qaytaradi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

content.en:
A learner phones a language tutor to ask about a trial lesson. The tutor is available in the afternoon, but the learner has classes then. They agree on Saturday morning and repeat the time clearly.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
O‘quvchi ustozga qo‘ng‘iroq qilib sinov darsini so‘raydi. Ular shanba tongiga kelishadi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

content.en:

content.headingEn: New expressions: Explaining a service problem
Case study: Explaining a service problem
content.en:
A customer calls an internet provider because the connection has failed three times this week. The support agent asks for the account number and offers a technician visit. The customer describes the timeline calmly and confirms the appointment.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Mijoz internet uzilishi haqida operatorga murojaat qiladi. Voqealar ketma-ketligini tushuntirib, ustaning kelish vaqtini tasdiqlaydi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

content.headingEn: Case study: Presenting a small proposal
content.en:
A student proposes a weekly English conversation club. She explains the purpose, expected benefits, approximate cost and how interested students can join. Another student questions whether beginners would feel comfortable, so she suggests mixed-level pairs.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Talaba haftalik suhbat klubi taklifini taqdim etadi va boshlovchilar ham qatnashishi uchun juftlik taklif qiladi.

lesson.titleEn: Negotiating with constraints · Spoken English Advanced
objectivesEn: Identify the communication goal in negotiating with constraints.
Understand and use 7 new topic-specific English expressions with Uzbek meanings.
Interpret the case, perform an oral task and justify four checkpoint answers.
objectivesUz: “Cheklovlar bilan muzokara” mavzusidagi muloqot maqsadini aniqlang.
7 ta yangi inglizcha iborani o‘zbekcha ma’nosi bilan o‘rganing.
Vaziyatni tushuning, og‘zaki mashq qiling va to‘rtta test javobini asoslang.

content.en: Your task in “Negotiating with constraints” is to recognise when “negotiating with constraints” is useful. Practise a natural exchange, give a relevant follow-up answer, and check whether your choice of words fits the situation. Read the case carefully and connect each new expression to a detail in the text; do not memorise an unrelated script.
content.uz: “Cheklovlar bilan muzokara” darsida “cheklovlar bilan muzokara” iborasining qachon ishlatilishini aniqlang. Tabiiy suhbatni mashq qiling, mos qo‘shimcha javob bering va so‘zlaringiz vaziyatga mosligini tekshiring. Matndagi tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering va mavzuga aloqasiz gaplarni yodlamang.
content.modelEn: Would a partial shipment this week be feasible while we finalise the revised timetable?
content.modelUz: Yangilangan jadvalni kelishgunimizcha shu hafta qisman jo‘natish mumkinmi?

content.en:
A supplier cannot meet the original delivery date because of a transport delay. The buyer needs half the items immediately for a public event. Both sides explore partial delivery, a clear revised schedule and who will cover additional costs.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Yetkazib beruvchi kechikmoqda, xaridorga esa mahsulotning yarmi zudlik bilan kerak. Ular qisman yetkazish va xarajatni kelishadi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

content.headingEn: Case study: Public talk and questions
content.en:
A researcher presents a proposal for energy-efficient university buildings. After a concise summary of the evidence, the audience asks about cost, uncertainty and long-term maintenance. The speaker acknowledges what is not yet known and explains the next evaluation step.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Tadqiqotchi energiya tejamkor binolar taklifini taqdim etadi. Savollarda xarajat, noaniqlik va texnik xizmat haqida so‘raladi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

content.headingUz: Yangi iboralar: Kasbiy kelishmovchilikni hal qilish

content.en:
Two managers disagree about whether a new service should launch immediately. One fears missed opportunities; the other cites unresolved security issues. A mediator asks for evidence, identifies non-negotiable safeguards and proposes a conditional decision.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Ikki menejer ishga tushirish sanasida kelisha olmaydi. Vositachi dalillarni so‘rab, xavfsizlik talabiga asoslangan shartli qaror taklif qiladi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

content.headingEn: New expressions: At a public service office
Case study: At a public service office
content.en:
A resident visits a public service centre to renew a document. The clerk explains the required identification and asks the resident to complete a form. One document is missing, so the resident asks whether it can be submitted online later.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Fuqaro hujjatni yangilash uchun xizmat markaziga boradi. Bir hujjat yetishmaydi, uni keyin onlayn yuborish mumkinligini so‘raydi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

content.headingEn: New expressions: On a university campus
Case study: On a university campus
content.en:
An exchange student arrives at a university campus in Tashkent and cannot find the library. Another student gives directions and explains that a student card is needed to borrow books. They arrange to meet after the orientation session.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Almashinuv talabasi Toshkent universitetida kutubxonani izlaydi. Talaba yo‘lni va kutubxona kartasi tartibini tushuntiradi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.

content.headingEn: Case study: At a bank branch
content.en:
A customer asks a bank employee how to open a basic account. The employee explains which documents to bring and whether there are monthly fees. The customer asks for written information and repeats the most important conditions.

This practice case is written for learners in Uzbekistan. Read the situation once for the main point. Read it again for the people, problem and proposed next action. The main challenge is to choose precise language for this situation. A good response should be relevant, polite, and supported by a detail from the scenario. When you finish, compare your response with the model and explain one improvement.
content.uz:
Mijoz hisob ochish hujjatlari va oylik xizmat haqqini bankdan so‘raydi. Muhim shartlarni qaytarib aniqlaydi.

Avval vaziyatning asosiy ma’nosini toping. Keyin muammo, odamlar va keyingi qadamni belgilang. Javobingiz vaziyatga mos, xushmuomala va aniq bo‘lsin. Namunaga solishtirib, bitta yaxshilash usulini yozing.
